lessons.vocab_topic: Essential Words 1 — Education (ta'lim, akademik so'zlar)
lessons.book_ref: Student's book IELTS 4.0: Lesson 1 – Prefixes (ixtiyoriy; dars kitobsiz o'tadi). Writing: Kitob SAMPLE ESSAYS, 11-o'rin (money management) — faqat savol; namuna original. Kitob audiolari ishlatilmaydi; listening — Jony Academy skripti. Reading — Abdurauf Fitrat (Jony Academy matni).
objectives: Dars oxirida o'quvchi 12 ta asosiy prefiksning ma'nosini biladi: 6 gapni prefiksli so'z bilan qayta yozish mashqida kamida 5 tasini to'g'ri bajaradi.
Dars oxirida o'quvchi inkor prefiksini (un-/in-/im-/ir-/il-/dis-/non-) to'g'ri tanlaydi: 10 so'zli mashqda kamida 8 ta to'g'ri, jumladan unpopular / impolite kabi juftliklarda.
Dars oxirida o'quvchi ta'lim mavzusidagi Part 2 kartochkasi bo'yicha 1.5 daqiqa gapiradi va CORE 20 dan kamida 2 so'z ishlatadi.
Dars oxirida o'quvchi 'Money management at school' savoli bo'yicha Body 2 ni 60–80 so'zda yozadi, unda 2–3 prefiksli so'zni tabiiy ishlatadi va W-CHECK ning 7 bandidan kamida 5 tasini bajaradi.

timeline: Salomlashish + kirish savoli

Ustoz doskaga "happy, write, possible, agree, national" yozadi; o'quvchilar prefiks qo'shib yangi so'z yasaydi: unhappy, rewrite, impossible, disagree, international (2 daq). Juftlikda (2 daq): "What do you like most about your school?"
KIRISH: kurs tanishuvi + diagnostika

3 daq — 4.0 kursi tartibi: har dars boshida o'tgan dars Kahooti va Essential Words yozma normativi; Kombinatsiya — juftlikda formula → gap → tarjima zanjiri; normativ — belgilangan vaqtda bajariladigan qisqa o'lchov, natijasiga qarab coin. 5 daq — diagnostik yozuv: "Describe your school in 5 sentences" (yakka, ustoz yig'ib oladi, baho qo'yilmaydi). 5 daq — Speaking Part 1 juftlikda: 4 savol (proyektorda: Where do you study? What is your favourite subject? Why are you learning English? What do you do after school?). 4.0 da insho darslari: sinfda tahlil + Body 2, uyda to'liq insho; Speaking darslarida uyga ovozli SPEAKING NORMATIV.
YANGI GRAMMATIKA — Prefikslar (12 asosiy) + CCQ

Lead-in: possible → impossible, lekin popular → unpopular — nega? → formula (proyektor, formulas 1–5: 12 asosiy prefiks) → 2–3 misol + notes (in- → im-/ir-/il-; 'O'quvchi so'raydi') → CCQ (presentation) → mistakes doskada birga tuzatiladi (3 daq) → 1 daq tez og'zaki tekshiruv: ustoz so'z aytadi, o'quvchi inkor shaklini aytadi. ZAXIRA prefikslar (formulas 6–7) — vaqt qolsa yoki reading glossary orqali.
LUG'AT — Essential Words 1 CORE 20

Ustoz 20 so'zni proyektorda talaffuz + tarjima bilan o'qitadi (3 daq); 6–8 ta qiyin so'zga CCQ yoki misol (3 daq); juftlikda A o'zbekchasini, B inglizchasini aytadi (2 daq). Mustahkamlash — flashcard (uyga).
Kombinatsiya — prefiks + so'z → gap

Kombinatsiya — juftlikda formula → gap → tarjima zanjiri: A formulani yoki o'zbekcha gapni aytadi, B shu formula bilan inglizcha gap tuzib tarjima qiladi, keyin almashadi. 1 daq — ustoz grammar.formulas dan formulani va 1 misolni proyektorda ko'rsatadi; 3 daq — juftlikda (me'yor normativ[1] da); ustoz 2 juftlikni tinglaydi.
SINF MASHQLARI — Ex1–Ex4 (MAJBURIY) + ZAXIRA
Ex1 5 daq yakka · Ex2 4 daq juftlik · Ex3 4 daq yakka · Ex4 4 daq yakka; ZAXIRA (reading'dagi 'ZAXIRA: prefiksli so'zlarni toping') — uyga (WRITING bosqichiga 3 daq berildi).
SPEAKING — Part 2 + Part 3

class_ex SPEAKING, juftlikda: 1 daq — kartochka proyektorda + ICQ; 1 daq — tayyorgarlik (5–6 kalit so'z); 2 daq — A gapiradi (kartochka A), B checklist to'ldiradi; 2 daq — B gapiradi (kartochka B); 3 daq — 3 ta Part 3 savoli; 1 daq — ustoz umumiy feedback (S-4.0).
READING — Abdurauf Fitrat
1 daq — gist (1-topshiriq savollarini o'qish); 7 daq — o'qish + TFNG; 3 daq — completion; 2 daq — tekshirish, NOT GIVEN izohi.
LISTENING — IELTS Part 1
1 daq — savollarni o'qish; 1-tinglash (3 daq); 2-tinglash (3 daq); 1 daq — javoblar proyektorda.
WRITING — Money management at school

class_ex WRITING bo'yicha. 3 daq — savol tahlili: savol turi (agree/disagree), kalit so'zlar (children, manage money, at school), pozitsiya, nechta body; kursdagi birinchi insho — 4 abzatsli qolip proyektorda (kirish: parafraz + pozitsiya / Body 1 / Body 2 / xulosa). 5 daq — NAMUNA kirish + Body 1 tahlili (box, proyektorda: topic sentence, bog'lovchi, bugungi grammatika — prefiksli so'zlar, EW so'zlari). 5 daq — yakka Body 2 (60–80 so'z). 2 daq — sherik W-CHECK-4.0 bilan tekshiradi; to'liq insho uyga (W-4.0).
Xatolar ustida ishlash + uyga vazifa

4 daq — dars davomida ustoz yozib borgan 4–5 ta og'zaki/yozma xato doskada, o'quvchilar tuzatadi (error log); 3 daq — uyga vazifa: 1–4 majburiy, 5–6 qo'shimcha; insho savoli ('Money management at school', 40 daq, 220–260 so'z) proyektorda. Vaqt yetmasa: ZAXIRA mashqlar va reading'ning 'find' topshirig'i uyga o'tadi.

intro: Prefiks — so'z BOSHIGA qo'shiladi va ma'noni o'zgartiradi. Ko'pchilik prefikslar turkumni o'zgartirmaydi: happy (sifat) → unhappy (sifat). Istisno: en-/em- sifat yoki otdan fe'l yasaydi (enable, empower), de- ham ba'zan (frost → defrost).

INKOR: un- (unhappy), in- (invisible), dis- (disagree), non- (non-native). Agar so'z in- oladigan bo'lsa, in- p/b/m oldida im-, r oldida ir-, l oldida il- ga aylanadi (impossible, irregular, illegal). Lekin ko'p so'z un- oladi: unpopular, unreliable, unlimited — qaysi prefiks olishini lug'atdan tekshiring.
MA'NO: re- (qayta), pre- (oldin), mis- (noto'g'ri), over-/under- (ortiqcha/kam), inter- (orasida), multi- (ko'p), co- (birga). ZAXIRA prefikslar — formulas oxirida.
formulas: Inkor: un- / dis- / non-
un + sifat (ba'zan fe'l); dis + fe'l / sifat; non + ot / sifat
unhappy, unlock, disagree, dishonest, non-native
baxtsiz, qulfni ochmoq, rozi bo'lmaslik, insofsiz, ona tili bo'lmagan
Inkor: in- va uning shakllari
in + sifat; p/b/m oldida im-, r oldida ir-, l oldida il- (faqat in- oladigan so'zlarda)
invisible, impossible, irregular, illegal
ko'rinmas, imkonsiz, tartibsiz, noqonuniy
Qayta / oldin / noto'g'ri
re- / pre- / mis- + fe'l
rewrite, preview, misunderstand
qayta yozmoq, oldindan ko'rmoq, noto'g'ri tushunmoq
Ortiqcha / kam
over- / under- + fe'l / sifat
overwork, overcrowded, underpaid, underestimate
haddan tashqari ishlamoq, odam haddan tashqari ko'p, kam haq to'langan, kam baholamoq
Orasida / ko'p / birga
inter- / multi- / co-
international, multicultural, cooperate, co-author
xalqaro, ko'p madaniyatli, hamkorlik qilmoq, hammuallif
ZAXIRA: joy va yo'nalish
sub- / super- / trans- / anti-
submarine, superstar, transport, antisocial
suvosti kemasi, superyulduz, transport, g'ayriijtimoiy
ZAXIRA: son va boshqa
auto- / semi- / bi- / mono- / de- / en-/em-
automatic, semicircle, bilingual, monologue, defrost, empower
avtomatik, yarim doira, ikki tilli, monolog, muzdan tushirmoq, kuch bermoq
presentation: Is it possible to learn a language in a month?
No, it's impossible — but it's possible to learn the basics.
Did you understand the lecture?
I misunderstood one part, so I re-read my notes.
Is your school international?
Yes, it's multicultural — students from six countries.
Are young graduates well paid?
Not always — many are underpaid and overworked.
CCQ: The exam timetable is irregular.
Is it the same every week? (No) Does it change often? (Yes)
CCQ: I misunderstood the question.
Did I understand it correctly? (No) Was my answer probably right? (No)
CCQ: She is going to rewrite her essay.
Has she already written it? (Yes) Will she write it again? (Yes)
CCQ: Many graduates are underpaid.
Do they get enough money? (No) Too much or too little? (Too little)
notes: Ko'pchilik prefikslar turkumni o'zgartirmaydi (happy → unhappy); turkumni asosan suffiks o'zgartiradi (2-dars). Istisno: en-/em- (able → enable, power → empower).
im- faqat b/m/p oldida: impossible, immature, imbalance; ir- faqat r: irresponsible; il- faqat l: illogical.
dis- ko'pincha fe'l bilan: disagree, disappear, dislike; un- sifat bilan: unable, unfair, unusual.

O'quvchi so'raydi: Nega impopular emas, unpopular? — Javob: im- faqat in- oladigan so'zlarda p oldida chiqadi (possible → impossible). popular so'zi in- emas, un- oladi; shuning uchun unpopular, unreliable, unlimited.
O'quvchi so'raydi: non- va un- farqi nima? — Javob: non- ko'pincha neytral 'emas' (non-native, non-smoker); un- ko'pincha baho beradi (unprofessional — yomon, noprofessional ishlaydigan).
mistakes: possible in- oladi; p oldida in- → im-.
regular in- oladi; r oldida in- → ir- (lekin reliable → unreliable).
legal in- oladi; l oldida in- → il- (lekin limited → unlimited).
popular un- oladi; im- qoidasi faqat in- oladigan so'zlarga tegishli.

how: CORE 20 — ta'limning akademik so'zlari; STRONG — jarayon va odamlar; SUPER — Writing/Speaking uchun ta'lim kollokatsiyalari. Har so'zga prefiksli juft izlang: literate → illiterate; graduate → postgraduate.
Misolda so'zning o'zi albatta bo'ladi, gap tabiiy va faktik to'g'ri; bugungi grammatika qolipi — ixtiyoriy, faqat tabiiy tushsa.

items: Last year my cousin started university in Samarkand. At first she felt uncomfortable, because the atmosphere in her faculty was very unformal and she didn't know how to behave. Her first lecturer was impopular with the students, but she liked his lessons. Some of her classmates were inresponsible and often missed seminars. She tried to talk to them, but they always misagreed with her and said her ideas were unlogical. By the end of the year, they understood that she was right.

class_ex.title: SPEAKING — Part 2: Education
class_ex.instr: (10 daq, juftlik) 1 daq — ustoz kartochkani proyektorda ko'rsatadi, ICQ: Necha daqiqa tayyorlanasiz? (1) Kim birinchi? (A). 1 daq — tayyorgarlik (faqat 5–6 kalit so'z yoziladi). 2 daq — A gapiradi, B sherik checklist'ini to'ldiradi. 2 daq — B boshqa kartochka bo'yicha gapiradi. 3 daq — juftlikda Part 3 savollari. 1 daq — ustoz 1 ta umumiy feedback (S-4.0 bo'yicha).
items: KARTOCHKA A: Describe a teacher who has influenced you. You should say: who this teacher is ; what subject he or she teaches ; what he or she did ; and explain why this teacher is important to you.
KARTOCHKA B: Describe a subject that was difficult for you at school. You should say: what the subject was ; when you studied it ; why it was difficult ; and explain what you did to deal with it.
Part 3: Should university education be free for everyone?
Part 3: Is online learning as effective as classroom learning?
Part 3: Why do some students drop out of school?
answers: NAMUNA A (faqat ustoz uchun, Band 5.5–6, 120–160 so'z): I'd like to talk about my English teacher from secondary school, Ms Dilnoza. She taught us for three years, and she is the reason I started to love languages. At first I was unmotivated, because grammar seemed boring and irrelevant to my life. But she never made us learn by rote. Instead, she organised debates and short projects, gave us extra tasks when we were ready, and when I misunderstood something, she explained it again patiently and never made me feel stupid. She also told me about scholarships for international universities, which I didn't know existed. She is important to me because she showed me that learning can be enjoyable. Thanks to her, I'm now preparing for IELTS and I hope to study abroad.

NAMUNA B: For me, the most difficult subject was physics. I studied it in the eighth and ninth grades. It was difficult because there were many formulas, and I often misunderstood the tasks. My marks were irregular — sometimes good, sometimes bad. To deal with it, I found a study partner, we watched short video lessons together and I re-did the tasks I had got wrong. By the end of the year, my results improved.

Part 3 namuna javoblari: 1) In my opinion, it should be free for talented students from disadvantaged backgrounds, because tuition fees are unaffordable for many families. 2) Not completely — online learning is flexible, but many students feel unmotivated without a teacher and classmates. 3) Some students drop out because of financial problems; others feel that the curriculum is irrelevant to their future job.
class_ex.note: Sherik checklist: 4 ta you should say bandi aytildimi? Bugungi struktura (prefiksli so'z) 1–2 marta? Bugungi CORE'dan 2 so'z? 1.5 daqiqadan uzoq gapirdimi? Ustoz har darsda 3–4 o'quvchini S-4.0 rubrikasi bo'yicha jurnalga qayd etadi.

class_ex.title: WRITING — Money management at school (yozma): Task 2 insho — tahlil va Body 2
class_ex.instr: (15 daq) 3 daq — savol tahlili va 4 abzatsli qolip (proyektorda); 5 daq — box dagi NAMUNA kirish + Body 1 tahlili (topic sentence, bog'lovchilar, prefiksli so'zlar, EW so'zlari); 5 daq — yakka Body 2, 60–80 so'z, qolip: Topic sentence -> Explain -> Example -> Link; 2 daq — sherik bilan almashib W-CHECK-4.0 bo'yicha tekshirish. ICQ: Body 2 necha so'z? (60–80) Kim tekshiradi va nima bilan? (Sherik, W-CHECK-4.0)
box: Question: Some people think that children should be taught how to manage money at school. Do you agree or disagree?

MODEL — Introduction: These days, many people argue that money management should be part of the school curriculum. I completely agree with this view. In my opinion, such lessons show young people what money is really worth, and they also give every child skills that some parents are unable to teach at home.

MODEL — Body 1: Firstly, learning about money at school teaches children to value it and to save. When students plan a simple weekly budget, they quickly see that their pocket money disappears if they overspend on snacks or mobile games. As a result, they start saving for something important. For example, a teenager who puts aside 20,000 som a week can buy simple headphones in about three months. Practical lessons like this also increase motivation, because students can use them in real life.
items: Insho qolipi (4 abzats): Introduction (savol parafrazi + pozitsiya) -> Body 1 -> Body 2 -> Conclusion.
1. Savol turi qanday: agree/disagree, discuss both views yoki causes/solutions?
2. Pozitsiya kirishning qaysi gapida? Savoldagi qaysi so'zlar parafraz qilingan?
3. Body 1 ning topic sentence'i qaysi? Misol qaysi gapda?
4. Bugungi grammatika (prefiksli so'zlar) namunaning qayerida?
5. Essential Words 1 (Education) so'zlaridan qaysilari bor?
TASK: Write Body 2 (60–80 words): Topic sentence -> Explain -> Example -> Link. Idea: parents cannot teach everything (bank cards, online loans, debt).
answers: Kalit 1: agree/disagree (opinion) — bitta aniq pozitsiya kerak; bu yerda 'agree', 2 body ikkalasi ham pozitsiyani qo'llaydi.
Kalit 2: pozitsiya — 'I completely agree with this view.'; parafraz: 'taught how to manage money at school' -> 'money management should be part of the school curriculum'.
Kalit 3: topic sentence — 'Firstly, learning about money at school teaches children to value it and to save.'; misol — 'For example, a teenager who puts aside 20,000 som a week…'.
Kalit 4: unable (un-), overspend (over-); Body 2 da — irresponsible (ir-).
Kalit 5: curriculum, motivation (box da); compulsory, assessment, literacy (Body 2 / xulosada).

NAMUNA Body 2 (faqat ustoz uchun): Secondly, parents cannot teach their children everything. Many mothers and fathers work long hours, and some of them do not understand modern banking themselves. However, young people now get a bank card very early and can borrow money online in a few minutes. For instance, some students in Uzbekistan buy expensive phones in instalments through mobile apps and later cannot pay back the debt. A compulsory course with regular assessment could protect them from such irresponsible decisions.

NAMUNA Conclusion (faqat ustoz uchun): In conclusion, I strongly believe that money management should be taught at school. These lessons show children why saving matters and protect them from debt, so their financial literacy does not depend on how rich or educated their parents are.
To'liq namuna: 247 so'z (kirish 50, Body 1 80, Body 2 77, xulosa 40).
Baholash: W-4.0 (jadval shu darsda); sinfdagi Body 2 — W-CHECK-4.0, to'liq insho uyda W-4.0 bilan.
why: Grammatika: unable (un- + able — 'qila olmaydigan'), overspend (over- + spend — 'ortiqcha sarflamoq'), irresponsible (r oldida in- -> ir-) — prefikslar tabiiy joyda, sanash uchun emas.
EW 1 so'zlari: curriculum (o'quv dasturi), motivation (motivatsiya), compulsory (majburiy), assessment (baholash), literacy (savodxonlik) — mavzuga mos 5 ta so'z.
Bog'lovchilar: Firstly, Secondly, As a result, For example, For instance, However, In conclusion — CC uchun 4+ xil.
O'zbek hayotidan misol: so'mda tejash va mobil ilovalarda bo'lib to'lashga telefon olish.

reading.title: Abdurauf Fitrat — the man who rewrote Uzbek education
text: A. Abdurauf Fitrat was born in 1886 in Bukhara, then the capital of an emirate with an unreformed, medieval education system. In traditional schools, many boys memorised Arabic texts for years without fully understanding them, and most girls received little education. Fitrat studied at a madrasa, but he was dissatisfied with what he learned. In 1909 he went to Istanbul, where he saw modern schools and a lively press, and he returned with an idea that was unpopular with conservative leaders: Bukhara had to rethink the way it educated its children.

B. He became one of the leading thinkers of the Jadids — the "new-method" reformers. In his books he argued that an illiterate nation could not be free or strong. He wrote textbooks and cooperated with other reformers to support new-method schools, where children learned science, geography and languages instead of relying on rote learning. Many conservative religious leaders strongly opposed these schools. When the emir's government turned against the reformers, he moved to Tashkent and continued his work there.

C. In the early 1920s Fitrat served for a short time as minister of education of the Bukhara republic. He helped to send young people to study in Germany on scholarships, and he wrote plays, poems and important works on Uzbek music and literature. His interdisciplinary mind moved easily between linguistics, history, drama and politics.

D. In 1937, during the Stalinist repressions, Fitrat was arrested, and in 1938 he was executed, together with Abdulla Qodiriy and Cho'lpon. For decades his books were banned. He was later officially rehabilitated, and after independence his works were published again. Today he is remembered as one of the founders of modern Uzbek education. His main idea was new for his time, but today it seems obvious: education is the precondition of a nation's independence.
(Jony Academy tomonidan o'quv maqsadida yozilgan matn.)

Receptionist: No, it's compulsory for all non-native speakers who have a place at the university, wherever they come from.
Caller: I see. And how much is the tuition?
Receptionist: Last year it was 450 dollars, but this year it's a bit cheaper — 400 dollars.
Caller: That's still a lot for my family.
Receptionist: Don't worry. Disadvantaged students can apply for a scholarship. Many people think the deadline is the 25th of August, but it's actually the 20th.
Caller: OK, the 20th. And do I have to come to the centre every day?
Receptionist: No, classes are semi-online. You study two days a week on the platform and three days here at the centre.
Caller: That sounds good.
Receptionist: One more thing, so you don't misunderstand: attendance is checked. If your attendance is irregular, you'll have to re-sit the whole course.
Caller: Right. Thank you very much.

kahoot.q: It's ___ to learn a new language in one week.
kahoot.explain: possible in- oladi; p oldida in- → im-: impossible. Lekin hamma p-so'z im- olmaydi: popular → unpopular.

kahoot.q: The exam timetable is ___ this term — it changes every week.
kahoot.explain: regular so'zi in- oladi; r oldida in- → ir-: irregular. Lekin reliable → unreliable (un-).

kahoot.q: Driving without a licence is ___ in Uzbekistan.
kahoot.explain: legal so'zi in- oladi; l oldida in- → il-: illegal. Lekin limited → unlimited (un-).

kahoot.q: I ___ the teacher's question, so my answer was wrong.
kahoot.explain: "Noto'g'ri" ma'nosi — mis-: misunderstand, misspell. dis- bu yerda ishlamaydi.

kahoot.q: Qaysi prefiks "QAYTA" ma'nosini beradi? (___write, ___read)
kahoot.explain: re- = qayta (rewrite, re-read); pre- = oldin; de- = pastga/yo'qotish; mis- = noto'g'ri.

kahoot.q: Qaysi gapda XATO bor?
kahoot.explain: Prefiks + to'g'ri turkum kerak: unemployed (sifat). "is unemploy" — xato.

kahoot.q: Many graduates are ___: they get very little money for hard work.
kahoot.explain: under- = kam, yetarli emas: underpaid (kam haq to'langan). over- = ortiqcha.

kahoot.q: Two scientists ___ the book: they wrote it together.
kahoot.explain: co- = birga: co-write, co-author, cooperate. re- = qayta, mis- = noto'g'ri.

kahoot.q: happy (sifat) → unhappy. "unhappy" qaysi so'z turkumi?
kahoot.explain: Ko'pchilik prefikslar turkumni o'zgartirmaydi: unhappy ham sifat. Istisno: en-/em- fe'l yasaydi (able → enable, power → empower).

kahoot.q: Qaysi so'z TO'G'RI yozilgan?
kahoot.explain: responsible so'zi in- oladi; r oldida in- → ir-: irresponsible (mas'uliyatsiz). Har r-so'z ir- olmaydi: unreliable.

kahoot.q: Students from 20 countries study here — the school is ___.
kahoot.explain: multi- = ko'p: multicultural (ko'p madaniyatli). mono- = bir, bi- = ikki.

kahoot.q: Tarjima: "Men bu fikrga qo'shilmayman."
kahoot.explain: agree fe'lining inkori — dis-: disagree (shuningdek dislike, disappear).

kahoot.q: Maths and English are ___ subjects — every student must take them.
kahoot.explain: compulsory = majburiy. optional = ixtiyoriy; extracurricular = darsdan tashqari.

kahoot.q: She won a ___, so she doesn't pay tuition fees.
kahoot.explain: scholarship = stipendiya/grant — o'qish to'lovini qoplaydi.

kahoot.q: Copying someone else's work and saying it's yours is called ___.
kahoot.explain: plagiarism = plagiat, birovning ishini o'ziniki qilib ko'rsatish.

kahoot.q: Students studying for a first (bachelor's) degree are ___.
kahoot.explain: undergraduate = bakalavr talabasi; postgraduate = magistr/doktorant; lecturer = o'qituvchi.

kahoot.q: He decided to ___ of university in his second year.
kahoot.explain: drop out of university = o'qishni tashlamoq. enrol on/in, graduate from, attend — boshqa qolip.

kahoot.q: "savodxonlik" — inglizcha?
kahoot.explain: literacy = savodxonlik; literature = adabiyot; lecture = ma'ruza.

kahoot.q: Learning facts by heart without understanding them is ___ learning.
kahoot.explain: rote learning = quruq yodlash. distance learning = masofaviy ta'lim.

kahoot.q: You need to ___ on the course before 1 September.
kahoot.explain: enrol on a course = kursga yozilmoq (qabul bo'lmoq).

Ustoz doskaga "pollute" yozadi; sinf oila yasaydi: pollution, polluted, polluter (1 daq). Juftlikda (2 daq): "What is the biggest environmental problem where you live?"
TAKROR: Kahoot — 1-dars (Prefixes)
'O'tgan dars Kahooti' tugmasi → 1-dars savollari (20 ta). Bugungi darsning Kahooti bu yerda EMAS — u 3-darsda o'ynaladi. Oxirgi 1 daqiqa: eng ko'p xato qilingan 2 savol izohi.
TAKROR: Yozma normativ — Essential Words 1 (Education)

Normativ — belgilangan vaqtda bajariladigan qisqa o'lchov; natijasiga qarab coin beriladi. 1-dars CORE 20: ustoz o'zbekchasini aytadi, o'quvchi inglizchasini yozadi — 4 daq; 1 daq sherik bilan almashib tekshirish. 18–20 = 2 coin; 15–17 = bajarildi; 14 va kam = 3-darsda qayta topshiradi.
Uy vazifasi tekshiruvi

Tarjima kaliti proyektorda (1 daq, o'quvchi o'zi belgilaydi). Yozma ishlar yig'ib olinadi (W-4.0 bo'yicha keyingi darsgacha tekshiriladi); eng ko'p uchragan 2 xato doskada (2 daq). Bajarmaganlar jurnalga.
YANGI GRAMMATIKA — Suffikslar (so'z turkumini yasash) + CCQ

Lead-in misoli (pollute → pollution → polluted → polluter) → formula (proyektor, grammar.formulas 1–5-qatorlar, 12 asosiy suffiks) → 2–3 misol + grammar.notes imlo qoidalari → CCQ (grammar.presentation) → 1 daqiqalik tez og'zaki tekshiruv: ustoz ildiz aytadi, o'quvchi kerakli turkumni aytadi. ZAXIRA suffikslar — vaqt qolsa.
LUG'AT — Essential Words 2 CORE 20

Ustoz 20 so'zni proyektorda talaffuz + tarjima bilan o'qitadi (3 daq); 6–8 ta qiyin so'zga CCQ yoki misol (3 daq); juftlikda A o'zbekchasini, B inglizchasini aytadi (2 daq). Mustahkamlash — flashcard (uyga).
Kombinatsiya — ildiz + suffiks → so'z → gap

Kombinatsiya — juftlikda formula → gap → tarjima zanjiri: A formulani yoki o'zbekcha gapni aytadi, B shu formula bilan inglizcha gap tuzib tarjima qiladi, keyin almashadi. 1 daq — ustoz grammar.formulas dan formulani va 1 misolni proyektorda ko'rsatadi; 3 daq — juftlikda (me'yor normativ[1] da); ustoz 2 juftlikni tinglaydi.

Ex1 5 daq yakka · Ex2 4 daq juftlik · Ex3 4 daq yakka · Ex4 4 daq yakka. ZAXIRA (imlo) — sinfda emas, uyga ixtiyoriy (WRITING insho bosqichi uchun 3 daqiqa shu bosqichdan olindi).

4 daq — dars davomida ustoz yozib borgan 4–5 ta og'zaki/yozma xato doskada, o'quvchilar tuzatadi (error log); 3 daq — uyga vazifa: 1–4 majburiy (4 — WRITING — Food waste: to'liq insho, 40 daq taymer bilan), 5–6 qo'shimcha; insho savoli proyektorda. Vaqt yetmasa: ZAXIRA mashqlar va reading'ning 'find' topshirig'i uyga o'tadi.

intro: Suffiks — so'z OXIRIga qo'shiladi va TURKUMNI o'zgartiradi: happy (sifat) → happiness (ot) → happily (ravish).
OT: -tion/-sion (creation, decision), -ment (development), -ness (happiness), -ity (activity); ODAM: -er/-or (teacher, actor), -ist (artist, environmentalist).
SIFAT: -able (renewable), -ful (beautiful), -less (hopeless), -ous (dangerous), -al (natural).
RAVISH: -ly (quickly, environmentally). ZAXIRA (vaqt qolsa): -ship, -hood, -ance/-ence, -ic, -y, -ed/-ing, -en (friendship, childhood, importance, poetic, snowy, polluted, widen).
IELTS: sustain (v) → sustainable (adj) → sustainability (n) → sustainably (adv) — bitta ildizdan to'rt shakl; to'g'ri shaklni tanlash LR va GRA uchun muhim.
formulas: Ot yasovchi
fe'l / sifat + -tion / -ment / -ness / -ity
creation, development, happiness, activity
yaratish, rivojlanish, baxt, faoliyat
Odam yasovchi
-er / -or / -ist
teacher, actor, artist, environmentalist
o'qituvchi, aktyor, rassom, ekolog-faol
Sifat yasovchi
ot / fe'l + -able / -ful / -less / -ous / -al
renewable, harmful, hopeless, dangerous, natural
qayta tiklanuvchi, zararli, umidsiz, xavfli, tabiiy
Ravish yasovchi
sifat + -ly (-al + -ly = -ally)
quickly, carefully, environmentally
tez, ehtiyotkorlik bilan, ekologik jihatdan
So'z oilasi
ildiz + suffikslar
sustain → sustainable → sustainability → sustainably
saqlab turmoq → barqaror → barqarorlik → barqaror tarzda
ZAXIRA: ot
-ship / -hood / -ance / -ence
friendship, childhood, importance, silence
do'stlik, bolalik, ahamiyat, sukunat
ZAXIRA: sifat
-ic / -y / -ed / -ing
poetic, snowy, polluted, polluting
she'riy, qorli, ifloslangan, ifloslantiruvchi
ZAXIRA: fe'l
sifat + -en
widen, strengthen
kengaytirmoq, kuchaytirmoq
presentation: Is the river drinkable?
No, it's undrinkable — dangerously polluted.
CCQ: Plastic is harmful to sea life.
Does plastic cause harm? (Yes) Is 'harmful' a thing or a description? (A description — sifat, -ful)
CCQ: She is an environmentalist.
Is she a person or a problem? (A person — -ist) Does she try to protect nature? (Yes)
CCQ: The river is dangerously polluted.
Is the river safe? (No) Which word tells us HOW polluted it is? (dangerously — ravish, -ly)
CCQ: Sustainability is important for our future.
Is 'sustainability' a noun or an adjective? (A noun — -ity) What is the adjective? (sustainable)
notes: Imlo: happy → happiness (y → i); create → creation (e tushadi); run → runner (qisqa unlidan keyingi undosh ikkilanadi).
-ful faqat bitta l: beautiful, careful; -fully: carefully.
O'quvchi so'raydi: Nega happyness emas, happiness? — Javob: undoshdan keyingi -y odatda i ga aylanadi (happy → happiness); unlidan keyin saqlanadi (enjoy → enjoyment).
O'quvchi so'raydi: -er yoki -or? — Javob: qat'iy qoida yo'q (teacher, actor); so'zni oilasi bilan yodlang.
O'quvchi so'raydi: environmental va environmentalist farqi? — Javob: environmental — sifat (an environmental problem), environmentalist — odam.

how: CORE 20 — atrof-muhit so'z oilalari (pollute/pollution, sustain/sustainable…); STRONG — muammo va yechim so'zlari; SUPER — Writing Task 2 uchun akademik birikmalar.
Misolda so'zning o'zi albatta bo'ladi, gap tabiiy va faktik to'g'ri; bugungi grammatika qolipi — ixtiyoriy, faqat tabiiy tushsa.

class_ex.title: Ex1 — Suffiks tanlang
class_ex.instr: (5 daq, yakka) Qavsdagi so'zni gapga mos turkumda yozing: ot, sifat, ravish yoki odam. 8 gap. ICQ: Nechta gap? (8) Yakka yoki juftlikda? (Yakka)

The ___ (pollute) of the river is serious.
Solar energy is ___ (renew).
We must act ___ (responsible).
She is an ___ (environment).
The ___ (destroy) of forests is often irreversible.
His ___ (commit) to conservation is strong.

class_ex.instr: (4 daq, juftlik) Har ildizdan to'rt turkum yasang: ot / sifat / ravish / odam; shakl bo'lmasa — «—». 8 ildiz. ICQ: Nechta ildiz? (8) Nechta ustun? (4)
items: pollute
sustain
environment
danger
care
develop
create
responsible

class_ex.instr: (4 daq, yakka) Ta'rifga qutidan so'z toping va uning suffiksi hamda turkumini yozing. 6 ta'rif. ICQ: Nechta ta'rif? (6) Faqat so'zni yozasizmi? (Yo'q — so'z + suffiks + turkum)

class_ex.title: SPEAKING — Part 2: Environment
class_ex.instr: (10 daq, juftlik) 1 daq — ustoz kartochkani proyektorda ko'rsatadi, ICQ: Necha daqiqa tayyorlanasiz? (1) Kim birinchi? (A). 1 daq — tayyorgarlik (faqat 5–6 kalit so'z yoziladi). 2 daq — A gapiradi, B sherik checklist'ini to'ldiradi. 2 daq — B boshqa kartochka bo'yicha gapiradi. 3 daq — juftlikda Part 3 savollari. 1 daq — ustoz 1 ta umumiy feedback (S-4.0 bo'yicha).
items: KARTOCHKA A: Describe an environmental problem in your city or village. You should say: what the problem is ; where you notice it ; what causes it ; and explain how it could be solved.
KARTOCHKA B: Describe something you do to protect the environment. You should say: what you do ; how often you do it ; who you do it with ; and explain why it is important to you.
Part 3: Who should do more to protect the environment: governments or individuals?
Part 3: Should plastic bags be banned?
Part 3: Will cities be cleaner in the future?
answers: NAMUNA A (faqat ustoz uchun, Band 5.5–6, 120–160 so'z): I'd like to talk about air pollution in my city. You can notice it especially in winter, when the sky looks grey and the air smells of smoke. I think there are several causes. First, there are too many old cars, and their emissions are harmful. Second, some houses still burn coal for heating. Also, a lot of trees have been cut down for new buildings, so there is less green space. In my opinion, the problem can be solved step by step. The government could introduce stricter regulation for old cars and make public transport cheaper. People could also plant more trees in their neighbourhoods. If everyone acts responsibly, the air will become much cleaner and healthier, and our city will be a nicer place to live.

NAMUNA B: I sort our rubbish at home. I started a year ago after a lesson about recycling. Now I collect plastic bottles and paper separately, and every Saturday my brother and I take them to a collection point. It is important to me because plastic is one of the most harmful kinds of waste, and I want to show my friends that small actions matter.

Part 3 namuna javoblari: 1) Both, but governments can do more because they make the laws, for example they can impose penalties on polluters. 2) Yes — plastic bags are very harmful, and reusable bags are an easy alternative. 3) Probably, if cities invest in electric buses and parks and people change their habits.

class_ex.title: WRITING — Food waste (yozma): Task 2 insho — tahlil va Body 2
class_ex.instr: (15 daq) 3 daq — savol tahlili: savol turi (causes + solutions), savolda nechta savol bor va nechta body kerak, pozitsiya. 5 daq — box dagi NAMUNA kirish va Body 1 ni proyektorda tahlil qilamiz: topic sentence, bog'lovchilar, suffiksli so'zlar, EW 2 so'zlari. 5 daq — yakka Body 2 (60–80 so'z): yechimlar. 2 daq — sherik bilan almashib W-CHECK-4.0 bo'yicha tekshirasiz. ICQ: Savolda nechta savol bor? (2 — sabablar va yechimlar) Body 2 da nima haqida yozasiz va necha so'z? (Yechimlar, 60–80 so'z)
box: Question: People today waste a lot of food. What are the reasons for this? What can be done to reduce food waste?

MODEL — Introduction: Nowadays a large amount of food is thrown away every day, both at home and at big family celebrations. In my opinion, this happens mainly because of careless shopping and poor storage, but the problem can be reduced if families, communities and schools take simple steps.

MODEL — Body 1: There are several reasons why people waste so much food. Firstly, many families buy more than they need, especially when products are cheap, so bread and vegetables go bad before anyone eats them. Secondly, food is frequently stored carelessly: meat is left outside the fridge, or fruit is kept in a warm kitchen. In Uzbekistan, weddings are another important reason, because hosts usually cook much more plov than their guests can eat. As a result, a lot of good food ends up in landfill, where it releases harmful gases.
items: Savol turi qanday? Savolda nechta savol bor va shuning uchun nechta body kerak?
Pozitsiya (asosiy javob) kirishning qaysi gapida?
Bugungi grammatika qayerda? Kirish va Body 1 dan suffiksli so'zlarni toping (kamida 3 ta) va turkumini ayting.
Qaysi EW 2 (Environment) so'zlari ishlatilgan?
Body 1 dagi bog'lovchilarni toping: sabablar qanday tartiblangan?
TASK: Write Body 2 (60–80 words) about solutions: Topic sentence -> Explain -> Example -> Link. Ideas: a shopping list / sharing leftover food / a school campaign.
answers: 1) Causes + solutions (sabab va yechim) — savolda 2 ta savol: 'What are the reasons…?' va 'What can be done…?'. Shuning uchun 2 ta body: Body 1 — sabablar, Body 2 — yechimlar.
2) Kirishning 2-gapi: 'In my opinion, this happens mainly because of careless shopping and poor storage, but the problem can be reduced if …' — ikkala savolga ham qisqa javob beradi.
3) Suffiksli so'zlar: careless (-less, sifat), celebrations (-tion, ot), carelessly (-less + -ly, ravish), harmful (-ful, sifat), frequently / especially (-ly, ravish).
4) EW 2: waste, harmful (CORE), ends up in landfill (SUPER); Body 2 va xulosada yana: natural resources, carbon footprint, sustainable (CORE).
5) Bog'lovchilar: Firstly, Secondly, because, so, As a result — 3 ta sabab: ortiqcha xarid, noto'g'ri saqlash, to'ylarda ortiqcha taom.

NAMUNA Body 2 + Conclusion (faqat ustoz uchun): However, there are practical solutions to this problem. The simplest one is a shopping list: if people plan their meals for the week, they buy only what they will use. In addition, leftover food from celebrations can be shared with neighbours or local charities instead of being thrown away. Schools can also organise a 'clean plate' campaign, where pupils learn about food management and the value of natural resources. Such small actions save money and reduce our carbon footprint. / In conclusion, food waste is mainly caused by buying too much, storing food badly and cooking for very large celebrations. A more sustainable lifestyle is possible, because careful planning, sharing and education can lead to a real reduction in waste, starting in every kitchen.
To'liq namuna: 258 so'z (kirish 46 · Body 1 89 · Body 2 79 · xulosa 44).
why: Bugungi grammatika (suffikslar): careless / carelessly (care + -less + -ly) — sifat va ravish bir oiladan; management (manage + -ment) va reduction (reduce + -tion: e tushadi) — ot; sustainable (sustain + -able) — sifat.
Body 2 dagi practical (-al), simplest (-est), management (-ment) va xulosadagi careful (-ful) kabi so'zlar ham suffiks bilan yasalgan — o'quvchi o'z Body 2 sida kamida 2 ta shunday so'z ishlatsin.

EW 2 so'zlari: waste — chiqindi/isrof; harmful — zararli; ends up in landfill — axlat poligoniga borib tushadi; natural resources — tabiiy resurslar; carbon footprint — uglerod izi; sustainable — barqaror.
O'zbek misoli: to'yda keragidan ko'p osh damlash — aniq, mahalliy misol TR va CC uchun ball beradi.

items: Question: People today waste a lot of food. What are the reasons for this? What can be done to reduce food waste?
Plan: 1) Introduction — paraphrase the question + your short answer (main reasons and main solutions).
Plan: 2) Body 1 — reasons: Topic sentence -> 2–3 reasons with explanation -> example from Uzbekistan.

answers: NAMUNA (Band 5.5–6, 258 so'z, Jony Academy original, faqat ustoz uchun):

Nowadays a large amount of food is thrown away every day, both at home and at big family celebrations. In my opinion, this happens mainly because of careless shopping and poor storage, but the problem can be reduced if families, communities and schools take simple steps.

There are several reasons why people waste so much food. Firstly, many families buy more than they need, especially when products are cheap, so bread and vegetables go bad before anyone eats them. Secondly, food is frequently stored carelessly: meat is left outside the fridge, or fruit is kept in a warm kitchen. In Uzbekistan, weddings are another important reason, because hosts usually cook much more plov than their guests can eat. As a result, a lot of good food ends up in landfill, where it releases harmful gases.

However, there are practical solutions to this problem. The simplest one is a shopping list: if people plan their meals for the week, they buy only what they will use. In addition, leftover food from celebrations can be shared with neighbours or local charities instead of being thrown away. Schools can also organise a 'clean plate' campaign, where pupils learn about food management and the value of natural resources. Such small actions save money and reduce our carbon footprint.

In conclusion, food waste is mainly caused by buying too much, storing food badly and cooking for very large celebrations. A more sustainable lifestyle is possible, because careful planning, sharing and education can lead to a real reduction in waste, starting in every kitchen.

reading.title: Leonardo DiCaprio — the actor whose foundation protects the planet
text: A. Leonardo DiCaprio was born in 1974 in Los Angeles. His acting career started early: at 19 he received his first Oscar nomination, and "Titanic" (1997) made him globally famous. But his success as an actor is only half of the story. In 1998 he created the Leonardo DiCaprio Foundation, an organisation whose mission is the protection of wildlife and the environment.

B. His environmentalism is practical. Over the years, the foundation has given many millions of dollars to conservation projects: the preservation of forests, the protection of endangered animals such as tigers, and the creation of marine reserves. Its work shows that environmental protection needs both passion and careful organisation. He has also invested in green businesses, for example companies that produce plant-based food.

C. He also uses films to raise awareness. His documentaries "The 11th Hour" (2007) and "Before the Flood" (2016) have been watched by millions of people, and teachers can use them in class to start discussions about pollution and energy. In 2014 the United Nations named him a Messenger of Peace with a special focus on climate change.

D. DiCaprio is not a perfect example, however. He travels a lot by plane, and his personal carbon footprint is large. Critics call this hypocritical and say that famous people should set a better example. The debate shows how difficult it is for anyone, even a committed environmentalist, to live a completely sustainable life.

E. When he finally won his Oscar in 2016 for "The Revenant", his speech was not only about acting. He used the moment to say that climate change is real, that it is happening now and that it is an urgent threat to humanity. Millions of people around the world watched the ceremony. Many fans know DiCaprio the actor, but DiCaprio the environmentalist is worth knowing too.
(Jony Academy tomonidan o'quv maqsadida yozilgan matn.)

intro: You will hear a tour guide talking to a group of visitors at the start of a Green City tour.
1-tinglash: eslatmalarni to'ldiring; 2-tinglash: javoblarni tekshiring.
Write ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.

tasks.title: Note completion — ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER
tasks.instr: Eslatmalarni to'ldiring. Har javobga ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER.
items: Length of the tour: ___ hours
Recycling centre: waste sorted into ___ categories
Solar farm: produces ___ megawatts
Solar farm: enough electricity for about ___ homes
Wetland reserve: ___ endangered bird species
Community garden: closed on ___
Café: uses ___ packaging

transcript: USTOZ UCHUN: 2 marta o'qing; monolog — ustoz (yoki kuchli o'quvchi) o'qiydi, o'z-o'zini tuzatishlarni aniq ayting.

Guide: Good morning, everyone, and welcome to the Green City tour. My name's Sara, and I'll be your guide today. The whole tour takes about two hours — sorry, I mean two and a half hours, because we've added a new stop this year.
Guide: Our first stop is the recycling centre. People often think the waste here is sorted into three categories, but it's actually sorted into five: paper, glass, metal, plastic and food waste.

Guide: Next, we'll visit the solar farm. The old panels produced 40 megawatts — no, sorry, the new panels give 45 megawatts. The sign at the entrance says that's enough for ten thousand homes, but in fact it's now enough for about twelve thousand.
Guide: After that, we'll walk to the wetland reserve. You'll probably see lots of ducks there, but the reserve is best known for three endangered bird species.
Guide: Our new stop is the community garden, where local families grow vegetables. It used to be open only at weekends, but now it's open every day except Monday.

Guide: Finally, the tour ends at the café. It's completely plastic-free. Many visitors expect paper packaging, but everything there comes in biodegradable packaging made from corn. And if you bring your own reusable bottle, the water is free. Right, let's go!

kahoot.q: Money doesn't always bring ___.
kahoot.explain: bring dan keyin OT kerak: happy + -ness, y → i: happiness.

kahoot.q: The road was icy, so she drove very ___.
kahoot.explain: Fe'lni (drove) ravish ta'riflaydi: careful + -ly = carefully (ikki l).

kahoot.q: Qaysi so'z TO'G'RI yozilgan?
kahoot.explain: -al + -ly = -ally: environmental → environmentally.

kahoot.q: My uncle protects nature and plants trees. He is an ___.
kahoot.explain: Odamni -ist yasaydi: environmentalist. environmental — sifat.

kahoot.q: sustain → sustainable → ___ (OT)
kahoot.explain: sustainable (sifat) + -ity = sustainability (ot). sustainably — ravish.

kahoot.q: Qaysi suffiks OT yasaydi?
kahoot.explain: -ness ot yasaydi (kindness). -ful va -ous — sifat, -ly — ravish.

kahoot.q: There is no hope of saving the old tree. The situation is ___.
kahoot.explain: is + SIFAT; umid yo'q → -less: hopeless. hopeful — umidli (ma'no zid), hopelessly — ravish.

kahoot.q: The ___ of the new park took two years.
kahoot.explain: create + -tion: oxirgi e tushadi → creation. creative — sifat.

kahoot.q: Qaysi gapda XATO bor?
kahoot.explain: -ful qo'shimchasi bitta l bilan yoziladi: beautiful, careful (carefully da esa -ful + -ly).

kahoot.q: This plastic bottle can be recycled. It is ___.
kahoot.explain: -able = '…sa bo'ladigan': recycle + -able → recyclable (e tushadi).

kahoot.q: This river is too ___ to swim in.
kahoot.explain: too + SIFAT: danger + -ous = dangerous.

kahoot.q: The government made a strong ___ to clean energy. (commit)
kahoot.explain: a strong + OT: commit + -ment = commitment (majburiyat, sodiqlik).

kahoot.q: Cutting down forests on a large scale is called ___.
kahoot.explain: de- = yo'qotish: deforestation. reforestation — o'rmonni qayta tiklash.

kahoot.q: Solar and wind power are ___ sources of energy.
kahoot.explain: renewable = qayta tiklanuvchi (tugamaydigan) energiya.

kahoot.q: Animals that may soon disappear forever are ___.
kahoot.explain: endangered = yo'qolib borayotgan. extinct = allaqachon yo'q bo'lgan.

kahoot.q: Coal, oil and gas are ___.
kahoot.explain: fossil fuels = qazilma yoqilg'i (ko'mir, neft, gaz).

kahoot.q: The total amount of CO2 one person produces is their carbon ___.
kahoot.explain: carbon footprint = uglerod izi.

kahoot.q: Paper bags are ___: they break down naturally in the soil.
kahoot.explain: biodegradable = tabiiy parchalanadigan.

kahoot.q: Water ___ is a big problem in Central Asia — there isn't enough.
kahoot.explain: scarcity = tanqislik (yetishmaslik); scarce = kam.

kahoot.q: "mas'uliyat" — inglizcha (OT)?
kahoot.explain: responsibility — ot; responsible — sifat (mas'ul).

lessons.title: Modal Verbs: ought to, be able to
lessons.grammar_topic: MODAL FE'LLAR — OUGHT TO (kerak, maslahat) va BE ABLE TO (qila olmoq, barcha zamonlarda) + modal takrori
lessons.vocab_topic: Essential Words 3 — Technology and innovation (texnologiya va innovatsiya)
lessons.book_ref: Student's book IELTS 4.0: Lesson 3 – Modal verbs (ixtiyoriy; dars kitobsiz o'tadi). Writing: Kitob SAMPLE ESSAYS, 1-o'rin — faqat savol; namuna original. Kitob audiolari ishlatilmaydi; listening — Jony Academy skripti. Reading — Bill Gates (Jony Academy matni).
objectives: Dars oxirida o'quvchi ought to / ought not to bilan maslahat beradi va savolda tabiiy 'Should I…?' ni tanlaydi (Ex1: 8 tadan kamida 6).
Dars oxirida o'quvchi can (kelajak uchun ham), will be able to, have been able to, was able to ni zamon va ma'noga qarab to'g'ri tanlaydi.
Dars oxirida o'quvchi could va was able to farqini CCQ va Ex2 da tushuntiradi.

Dars oxirida o'quvchi Part 2 kartochkasi bo'yicha 1.5 daqiqa gapiradi va 'Technology and social life' inshosining Body 2 sini 60–80 so'zda yozadi hamda W-CHECK-4.0 ning 7 bandidan kamida 5 tasini bajaradi.

timeline: Salomlashish + kirish savoli

Proyektorda: "What can your phone do that your parents' phones couldn't do 20 years ago?" — 2–3 o'quvchi javob beradi (3 daq). Ustoz: "I was able to fix my laptop last week. I'll be able to code in Python by June." (1 daq).
TAKROR: Kahoot — 2-dars (Suffixes)
'O'tgan dars Kahooti' tugmasi → 2-dars savollari (20 ta). Bugungi darsning Kahooti bu yerda EMAS — u 4-darsda o'ynaladi. Oxirgi 1 daqiqa: eng ko'p xato qilingan 2 savol izohi.
TAKROR: Yozma normativ — Essential Words 2 (Environment)

Normativ — belgilangan vaqtda bajariladigan qisqa o'lchov; natijasiga qarab coin beriladi. 2-dars CORE 20: ustoz o'zbekchasini aytadi, o'quvchi inglizchasini yozadi — 4 daq; 1 daq sherik bilan almashib tekshirish. 18–20 = 2 coin; 15–17 = bajarildi; 14 va kam = 4-darsda qayta topshiradi.
Uy vazifasi tekshiruvi

Tarjima kaliti proyektorda (1 daq, o'quvchi o'zi belgilaydi). Yozma ishlar yig'ib olinadi (W-4.0 bo'yicha keyingi darsgacha tekshiriladi); eng ko'p uchragan 2 xato doskada (2 daq). Bajarmaganlar jurnalga.
YANGI GRAMMATIKA — ought to, be able to, could vs was able to + CCQ

Lead-in misoli → formula (proyektor) → 2–3 misol → CCQ → 1 daqiqalik tez og'zaki tekshiruv. Lead-in: "I can help you tomorrow. / I'll be able to drive next year." — farqi? (2 daq); formulas 1–6 + intro (6 daq); presentation: ustoz so'raydi, 3–4 o'quvchi javob beradi (4 daq); CCQ qatorlari (4 daq); ustoz o'zbekcha gap aytadi, o'quvchi modal bilan inglizcha aytadi (2 daq).
LUG'AT — Essential Words 3 CORE 20

Ustoz 20 so'zni proyektorda talaffuz + tarjima bilan o'qitadi (3 daq); 6–8 ta qiyin so'zga CCQ yoki misol (3 daq); juftlikda A o'zbekchasini, B inglizchasini aytadi (2 daq). Mustahkamlash — flashcard (uyga).
Kombinatsiya — S + ought to / be able to + V1

Kombinatsiya — juftlikda formula → gap → tarjima zanjiri: A formulani yoki o'zbekcha gapni aytadi, B shu formula bilan inglizcha gap tuzib tarjima qiladi, keyin almashadi. 1 daq — ustoz grammar.formulas dan formulani va 1 misolni proyektorda ko'rsatadi; 3 daq — juftlikda (me'yor normativ[1] da); ustoz 2 juftlikni tinglaydi.
SINF MASHQLARI — Ex1–Ex4 (MAJBURIY) + ZAXIRA

Ex1 4 daq yakka · Ex2 4 daq juftlik · Ex3 4 daq yakka · Ex4 5 daq juftlik; har mashqdan keyin kalit proyektorda. ZAXIRA (reading 4-topshirig'i) bu darsda uyga o'tadi — 3 daqiqa WRITING bosqichiga berildi.

To'liq insho — uyga (40 daq).
Xatolar ustida ishlash + uyga vazifa

4 daq — dars davomida ustoz yozib borgan 4–5 ta og'zaki/yozma xato doskada, o'quvchilar tuzatadi (error log); 3 daq — uyga vazifa: 1–4 majburiy (4 — WRITING to'liq insho, 40 daqiqa taymer bilan), 5–6 qo'shimcha; insho savoli proyektorda. Reading'ning 4-topshirig'i (ZAXIRA) ham uyga.

intro: OUGHT TO + V1 — "kerak, to'g'ri bo'ladi" (should bilan bir xil, rasmiyroq): "You ought to study harder." Inkor: ought not to (oughtn't to); savol: "Ought I to call her?" (kam; odatda Should I…?).

BE ABLE TO + V1 — "qila olmoq": "She is able to swim" (= can), "They weren't able to come" (= couldn't), "I have been able to finish" (perfect). Kelajak: imkoniyat yoki ruxsat hozirdan bor bo'lsa, can kelajak uchun ham: "I can help you tomorrow." Kelajakda YANGI paydo bo'ladigan qobiliyat uchun will be able to: "I'll be able to drive next year." "will can" — xato.

could — o'tgandagi umumiy qobiliyat ("I could swim at five"); was able to — bitta aniq holatda uddaladi ("I was able to escape"). Inkorda couldn't aniq holat uchun ham to'g'ri ("I couldn't open the door yesterday"); see/hear bilan could ham to'g'ri ("I could see the stage").
Modal xaritasi: majburiyat — must/have to; maslahat — should/ought to; qobiliyat — can/be able to; ruxsat — can/may; ehtimol — may/might/could.
formulas: Ought to — darak
S + ought to + V1
You ought to study harder.
Sen ko'proq o'qishing kerak.
Ought to — inkor
S + ought not to + V1
You ought not to be rude.
Sen qo'pol bo'lmasliging kerak.
Ought to — savol
Ought + S + to + V1? (kam — odatda Should + S + V1?)
Ought I to call her now? → Should I call her now?
Hozir unga qo'ng'iroq qilishim kerakmi?
Be able to — darak
S + am/is/are/was/were/will be + able to + V1
She is able to swim well. / I will be able to code by June.
U yaxshi suza oladi. / Iyungacha dasturlay olaman.
Be able to — inkor / savol
S + be + not + able to / Be + S + able to…?
They aren't able to come today. / Are you able to help me?
Ular bugun kela olmaydi. / Menga yordam bera olasanmi?
Perfect / could vs was able to
have/has been able to; could (umumiy) — was able to (aniq holat)
I have been able to finish. / He could read at four; he was able to fix the bug yesterday.
Tugatishga muvaffaq bo'ldim. / U to'rt yoshida o'qiy olardi; kecha xatoni tuzata oldi.
presentation: Ought I to buy a new laptop? (kam, rasmiy; odatda: Should I buy…?)
You ought to wait — the new model is due in May.
Were you able to fix the connection?
Yes, I was able to fix it after an hour.
Should companies collect our data?
They ought not to collect more than they need.
Could Bill Gates code as a teenager?
Yes, he could code at 13, and at 19 he was able to co-write a BASIC program for early personal computers.
Are you able to work without your phone?
Honestly, I'm not able to concentrate without it — and I ought to change that.
CCQ: I can help you tomorrow.
Is it possible now to plan it? (Yes) Is it wrong? (No)
CCQ: I'll be able to drive next year.
Can I drive now? (No) Will I have this skill later? (Yes)
CCQ: He was able to fix the bug yesterday.
Did he fix it? (Yes) One situation or a general ability? (One situation) Was it easy? (Probably not)
CCQ: You ought to back up your files.
Is it advice or a law? (Advice) Is it similar to should? (Yes)
notes: ought to dan keyin doim to: "ought to go" ("ought go" — xato); should dan keyin to yo'q.

can — hozir va hozirdan mavjud imkoniyat bilan kelajak (I can help you tomorrow); could — o'tgan umumiy qobiliyat / muloyim so'rov; Perfect, infinitiv (to be able to) va kelajakdagi yangi qobiliyat — be able to.
"managed to" = was able to (aniq holatda uddaladi).
O'quvchi so'raydi: "I can help you tomorrow" xatomi? — Javob: yo'q, to'g'ri — imkoniyat hozirdan bor. Yangi qobiliyat uchun: I'll be able to drive next year.
O'quvchi so'raydi: Nega "I will can" emas? — Javob: ikki modal (will + can) ketma-ket kelmaydi; will be able to deyiladi.
O'quvchi so'raydi: ought to va should farqi bormi? — Javob: ma'nosi deyarli bir xil; ought to kamroq ishlatiladi, savolda odatda Should I…?
mistakes: I will be able to help you.
will + can — xato; will be able to (hozirdan mavjud imkoniyatda: I can help you tomorrow).
She can swim when she was five.
She could swim when she was five.
I could escape the fire yesterday.
I was able to escape the fire yesterday.

class_ex.instr: (4 daq, yakka) Qavsdagi fe'lning to'g'ri shaklini yozing — zamonga qarang. 8 gap. ICQ: Nechta gap? (8) Yakka yoki juftlikda? (Yakka)
items: You ___ (ought) limit your screen time.

class_ex.title: SPEAKING — Part 2: Technology in everyday life
class_ex.instr: (10 daq, juftlik) 1 daq — ustoz kartochkani proyektorda ko'rsatadi, ICQ: Necha daqiqa tayyorlanasiz? (1) Kim birinchi? (A). 1 daq — tayyorgarlik (faqat 5–6 kalit so'z yoziladi). 2 daq — A gapiradi, B sherik checklist'ini to'ldiradi. 2 daq — B boshqa kartochka bo'yicha gapiradi. 3 daq — juftlikda Part 3 savollari. 1 daq — ustoz 1 ta umumiy feedback (S-4.0 bo'yicha).
items: KARTOCHKA A: Describe a piece of technology you use every day. You should say: what it is ; when you got it ; what you use it for ; and explain how your life would be different without it.

KARTOCHKA B: Describe a time when you were able to solve a problem with the help of the internet. You should say: what the problem was ; when it happened ; how the internet helped you ; and explain how you felt afterwards.
Part 3: Should children under 12 have smartphones?
Part 3: Will robots be able to replace teachers?
Part 3: What problems does technology cause for families?
answers: NAMUNA A (faqat ustoz uchun, Band 5.5–6, 120–160 so'z): I'd like to talk about my laptop, which I use every single day. My parents bought it for me two years ago, when I started preparing for IELTS. I mainly use it for studying: I watch video lessons, write essays and check new words in an online dictionary. In the evenings I also use it for video calls with my cousin, who studies in another city. Before I had it, I wasn't able to practise listening at home, because our old computer was too slow. Without my laptop, my life would be much harder — I couldn't study whenever I wanted or stay in touch with my cousin so easily. Honestly, I ought to spend less time on it at night, but it's the most useful thing I own.

NAMUNA B: Last winter my phone stopped charging the day before an online test, and the repair shop was closed. I found a short video online about cleaning the charging port. I followed the steps and was able to charge my phone again. I felt proud because I solved the problem myself.

Part 3 namuna javoblari (2–3 gapdan): 1) Children under 12 ought not to have their own smartphones — they aren't able to control their screen time yet. 2) Robots will be able to check tests, but they won't be able to motivate students like a real teacher. 3) Family members look at screens during meals and talk less, so parents ought to set rules, for example no phones at dinner.
class_ex.note: Sherik checklist: S-CHECK-4.0 (pastdagi jadval); bu darsda 3-band uchun box o'rniga bugungi CORE so'zlaridan 2 tasi sanaladi. Ustoz har darsda 3–4 o'quvchini S-4.0 rubrikasi bo'yicha jurnalga qayd etadi.

class_ex.title: WRITING — Technology and social life (yozma): Task 2 insho — tahlil va Body 2
class_ex.instr: (15 daq) 3 daq — savol tahlili: savol turi, kalit so'zlar, pozitsiya, nechta body. 5 daq — box dagi NAMUNA kirish va Body 1 ni birga tahlil qilamiz (topic sentence, bog'lovchilar, bugungi grammatika, EW so'zlari). 5 daq — yakka Body 2, 60–80 so'z: qarshi fikr + javob ('Some people argue that … However, …'). 2 daq — sherik bilan almashib W-CHECK-4.0 bo'yicha tekshirish. ICQ: Body 2 necha so'z? (60–80) Body 2 qaysi ibora bilan boshlanadi? (Some people argue that …)
box: Question: Technology has made people more social. Do you agree or disagree?

MODEL — Introduction: These days, almost everyone owns a smartphone and uses social media every day. Some people think that this has brought us closer together, while others feel that it has pushed us apart. In my opinion, modern technology has helped people become more sociable, because it keeps us close to our families and helps us make new friends.

MODEL — Body 1: The main reason is that technology keeps families close even when they live far apart. Thanks to fast connectivity and cheap devices, people are able to see and hear their relatives every day. For example, my older brother is studying in South Korea, but we have a video call almost every evening. Last spring, on the morning of his most important exam, our whole family was able to wish him luck on a video call. As a result, distance no longer breaks family ties.
items: Savol turi qanday: agree/disagree, discuss both views yoki problem–solution? Nechta body kerak?
Pozitsiya kirishning qaysi gapida? Muallif rozimi (agree) yoki qarshimi (disagree)?
Body 1 da bugungi grammatika (be able to / was able to) qayerda? Nega 'could' emas?
Body 1 ning topic sentence qaysi gap? Qaysi Essential Words 3 so'zlari bor?
TASK: Write Body 2 (60–80 words): Topic sentence -> Explain -> Example -> Link. Start with 'Some people argue that …', then answer with 'However, …'.
answers: 1) Agree/disagree (opinion essay): bitta aniq pozitsiya, kirish + 2 body + xulosa.

2) Pozitsiya — kirishning 3-gapi: 'In my opinion, modern technology has helped people become more sociable…' — muallif ROZI (agree). Savol so'zlari parafraz qilingan: technology -> modern technology, made people more social -> helped people become more sociable.
3) 'people are able to see and hear their relatives' — hozirgi umumiy imkoniyat; 'our whole family was able to wish him luck' — o'tmishdagi BIR MARTALIK aniq natija, shuning uchun could emas.
4) Topic sentence: 'The main reason is that technology keeps families close even when they live far apart.' EW: social media (kirish), connectivity, devices (Body 1).

NAMUNA Body 2 + Conclusion (faqat ustoz uchun): Some people argue that too much screen time leads to social isolation among teenagers. However, for many young people the internet is actually the first step towards real friendships. For instance, online language clubs and football fan groups often organise real meetings for their members. Of course, parents ought to teach children to balance online chats with face-to-face interaction. In this way, technology adds to real friendships instead of replacing them. || In conclusion, I am convinced that modern technology brings people closer rather than pushing them apart. Although too much time online can be harmful, the internet helps us keep strong family ties and build new friendships.
To'liq namuna: 248 so'z (kirish 57, Body 1 84, Body 2 71, xulosa 36).
why: 'people are able to see and hear their relatives' — be able to hozirgi zamonda: umumiy imkoniyat; ma'nosi can bilan bir xil, yozma ishda rasmiyroq eshitiladi.
'our whole family was able to wish him luck' — o'tmishdagi aniq bir holatda uddalash: bunday joyda could emas, was able to ishlatiladi (bugungi could vs was able to qoidasi).
Body 2 namunasida ought to (maslahat) ishlatilgan — insho uchun should dan biroz rasmiyroq.
EW 3 so'zlari: social media, connectivity, devices (kirish va Body 1); Body 2 namunasida screen time, social isolation, face-to-face interaction.
Bog'lovchilar: while, because, Thanks to, For example, As a result — har biri yangi fikrni ochadi.
