reading.title: Bill Gates — the man who was able to put a computer on every desk
text: A. Bill Gates was born in 1955 in Seattle, in the north-west of the United States. At 13 he was able to use a computer terminal at his school — something very few schools had at that time. He ought to have been doing his homework, but instead he was often writing simple programs.

B. At 19, together with his school friend Paul Allen, he co-wrote a BASIC program for one of the first personal computers. In 1975 the two friends founded Microsoft, and Gates soon left Harvard University to work on the company full-time. He believed something that sounded impossible then: one day there would be a computer on every desk and in every home.

C. Gates was able to see what others couldn't: computers would become cheap, so the real money was in software. When IBM needed an operating system for its new personal computer, Microsoft licensed one to IBM instead of selling it, so it could license the same system to other companies too. By the late 1990s Microsoft was one of the most valuable companies in the world, and Windows was on most of the world's personal computers.

D. Not everyone admired him. A US court ruled that Microsoft had acted illegally to protect its monopoly, and some critics said its products were difficult to use. However, few people were able to deny his influence: for many years, the digital age ran largely on Microsoft software.

E. In 2000 he helped to set up a charity foundation, and he has promised to give away most of his fortune. Today the foundation spends billions of dollars on vaccines, health care and education in poorer countries, and it has been able to help make polio extremely rare around the world. "Technology is just a tool," Gates has said. He believes that people ought to use it to improve lives, especially the lives of the poorest.
(Jony Academy tomonidan o'quv maqsadida yozilgan matn.)
glossary: terminal — terminal (kompyuterga ulangan klaviatura va ekran)

tasks.title: Multiple choice
tasks.instr: Choose the correct letter, A, B, C or D.
items: 1 What does paragraph A mainly describe? A) Gates's family B) Gates's first experience with computers C) Gates's university life D) the history of Seattle

2 Why did Microsoft license its operating system to IBM instead of selling it? A) IBM did not have enough money B) the law did not allow Microsoft to sell it C) Microsoft wanted to offer the same system to other companies D) Gates did not trust IBM
3 What is the main idea of paragraph D? A) Gates had critics, but his influence was huge B) Microsoft lost most of its customers C) Gates agreed with his critics D) the court closed Microsoft

tasks.title: TRUE / FALSE / NOT GIVEN
tasks.instr: Do the following statements agree with the information in the text? Write TRUE, FALSE or NOT GIVEN.
items: As a teenager, Gates had access to a computer at his school.
Gates finished his degree at Harvard before he started Microsoft.
The computer terminal at Gates's school was very expensive.
Microsoft sold its operating system to IBM.
IBM paid Microsoft more money than any other company did.
Gates thinks technology should be used to make people's lives better.
why: A: 'At 13 he was able to use a computer terminal at his school'.
B: 'Gates soon left Harvard University'.
A: narxi haqida ma'lumot yo'q.
C: 'licensed one to IBM instead of selling it'.
C: to'lovlar haqida ma'lumot yo'q.
E: 'people ought to use it to improve lives'.

tasks.title: Sentence completion — NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS
tasks.instr: Complete the sentences. Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS from the text for each answer.
items: Gates believed there would one day be a computer on every desk and in every ___.
Gates realised that the real money was in ___.
A US court said Microsoft had acted illegally to protect its ___.
The foundation has been able to help make ___ extremely rare.

tasks.title: ZAXIRA: Matndan modal fe'llarni toping
tasks.instr: Har paragrafdan ko'rsatilgan shaklni toping va gapni yozing.
items: A: was able to (o'tgan, aniq holat)
A: ought to have + V3
C: was able to + couldn't
D: were able to
E: has been able to
answers: At 13 he was able to use a computer terminal at his school.
He ought to have been doing his homework.
Gates was able to see what others couldn't.
Few people were able to deny his influence.
It has been able to help make polio extremely rare.

listening.audios: Audio fayl yo'q — ustoz transcript'ni o'qiydi (kitobdagi Audio 11–15 bu darsda ishlatilmaydi).
intro: You will hear a student talking to her tutor about a survey on screen time.
1-tinglash: javoblarni yozing; 2-tinglash: javoblarni tekshiring.
Write ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.

tasks.title: Note completion — ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER
tasks.instr: Complete the notes. Write ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.
items: Survey group: only ___
Number of people who answered: ___
Most can't sleep without their ___ next to the bed
Average time online per day: ___ hours
In 2015: ___ percent couldn't sleep without a phone
Conclusion should be about: ___
Type of chart: a ___ chart
Send the draft by: ___

transcript: USTOZ UCHUN: 2 marta o'qing; 1-rol — ustoz, 2-rol — kuchli o'quvchi (yoki ovozni o'zgartiring).
Tutor: Hi Dilnoza. How's your survey on screen time going?
Student: Not very well, I'm afraid. I wasn't able to finish it last week. I asked people of all ages, and the results were a mess.
Tutor: I think you ought to narrow the topic. Why not focus on teenagers only?
Student: Yes, teenagers. I already have answers from 45 of them — sorry, 54. I mixed up the numbers.
Tutor: That's enough for a small study. What did they say about sleep?
Student: Most of them said they aren't able to sleep without their phones next to the bed.
Tutor: Interesting. And how many hours a day are they online?
Student: At first I thought it was about four hours, but when I checked the forms, the average was six.
Tutor: Six hours is a lot. You ought to compare that with older data. There's a report from 2015 in the library.
Student: I've seen it. Back then only 30 percent said they couldn't sleep without a phone. Now it's 70 percent.
Tutor: So the number has more than doubled. Then your conclusion ought to be about addiction, not about technology in general.
Student: Good idea. Should I add a chart?
Tutor: Yes, a bar chart would be clearer than a pie chart. And please send me the draft by Thursday — no, make it Friday. I'm away on Thursday.
Student: Friday. Great, thanks!

kahoot.q: You ___ study harder if you want a 6.5.
kahoot.explain: ought dan keyin doim TO + V1: ought to study.

kahoot.q: I'm free tomorrow, so I ___ help you.
kahoot.explain: Imkoniyat hozirdan bor → can kelajak uchun ham ishlatiladi: I can help you tomorrow (I'll be able to ham to'g'ri). will can — xato.

kahoot.q: She ___ swim when she was five.
kahoot.explain: O'tgan zamondagi umumiy qobiliyat → could.

kahoot.q: The building was on fire, but everyone ___ escape.
kahoot.explain: Bitta aniq holatda uddalash → was able to (managed to). could — umumiy qobiliyat.

kahoot.q: You ___ be rude to your teachers.
kahoot.explain: Inkor: ought NOT to + V1 (oughtn't to). do/don't ishlatilmaydi.

kahoot.q: Since I bought a laptop, I ___ work from home.
kahoot.explain: Present Perfect'da can shakli yo'q → have been able to.

kahoot.q: Qaysi savol to'g'ri va eng tabiiy?
options: Do I ought to call her now?
Should I to call her now?
kahoot.explain: Maslahat so'raganda odatda Should I + V1? ishlatiladi. Ought I to…? — to'g'ri, lekin kam va rasmiy; 'Ought I call' (to yo'q) va 'do … ought' — xato.

kahoot.q: Qaysi gapda XATO bor?
options: He oughts to see a doctor.
I'll be able to code by June.
kahoot.explain: Modal fe'l -s olmaydi: He ought to (oughts emas).

kahoot.q: Tarjima: "Ular kecha kela olmadi."
options: They weren't able to come yesterday.
They didn't able to come yesterday.
They aren't able to come yesterday.
kahoot.explain: O'tgan inkor: weren't able TO + V1. able oldidan did ishlatilmaydi.

kahoot.q: After this course, you ___ write a Task 2 essay.
kahoot.explain: Kelajakda YANGI paydo bo'ladigan qobiliyat → will be able to. Ikki modal (will can, can be able) ketma-ket kelmaydi.

kahoot.q: "I managed to fix it" = I ___ fix it.
kahoot.explain: managed to = was able to (aniq holatda uddaladi).

kahoot.q: ought to ma'nosi qaysi modalga eng yaqin?
kahoot.explain: ought to = should (maslahat, to'g'ri bo'ladi), biroz rasmiyroq.

kahoot.q: Old phones that nobody uses any more are ___.
kahoot.explain: obsolete = eskirgan. cutting-edge = eng ilg'or.

kahoot.q: Spending too many hours online can lead to social ___.
kahoot.explain: social isolation = ijtimoiy yakkalanish.

kahoot.q: Bullying people on the internet is called ___.
kahoot.explain: cyberbullying = kiberbulling (internetda tahqirlash).

kahoot.q: The gap between people with and without internet access is the digital ___.
kahoot.explain: digital divide = raqamli tafovut. digital footprint = raqamli iz.

kahoot.q: This app is very ___ — even my grandmother can use it.
kahoot.explain: user-friendly = foydalanish oson, qulay.

kahoot.q: Doing several things at the same time is ___.
kahoot.explain: multitasking = bir vaqtda ko'p ish qilish; telecommuting = masofaviy ish.

kahoot.q: "maxfiylik" (shaxsiy ma'lumot) — inglizcha?
kahoot.explain: privacy = maxfiylik, shaxsiy hayot daxlsizligi.

kahoot.q: Scientists have made a major ___ in cancer research.
kahoot.explain: make a breakthrough = katta yutuqqa erishmoq.

lessons.title: Other Ways of Referring to the Future
lessons.grammar_topic: KELAJAKNI IFODALASHNING BOSHQA YO'LLARI (be going to, Present Continuous, Present Simple, be about to, be due to, be to, be set to, be bound/sure to, be likely/unlikely to)
lessons.vocab_topic: Essential Words 4 — Work and careers (ish va karyera)
lessons.book_ref: Student's book IELTS 4.0: Lesson 4 – Other ways of referring to the future (ixtiyoriy; dars kitobsiz o'tadi). Writing: Kitob SAMPLE ESSAYS, Topic 9 — faqat savol; namuna original. Kitob audiolari ishlatilmaydi; listening — Jony Academy skripti. Reading — Kylian Mbappé (Jony Academy matni).
objectives: Dars oxirida o'quvchi 9 ta kelajak shaklidan kamida 6 tasini ma'nosiga mos tanlab, yangi gapda to'g'ri ishlatadi.

Dars oxirida o'quvchi 'working longer hours' (causes + effects) savoli bo'yicha Body 2 ni 60–80 so'zda yozadi, is likely to / is bound to / is going to dan 2 tasini to'g'ri ishlatadi va W-CHECK ning 7 bandidan kamida 5 tasini bajaradi.
Dars oxirida o'quvchi Part 2 kartochkasi (kelajakdagi ish yoki kelasi yil rejalari) bo'yicha 1.5 daqiqa gapiradi.
Dars oxirida o'quvchi Essential Words 4 CORE 20 dan kamida 15 tasini o'zbekchadan inglizchaga to'g'ri aytadi.
materials: Grammatika formulalari — tizimdagi grammar.formulas (proyektor).
Essential Words 4 CORE 20 — tizimdagi lug'at ro'yxati / Lug'at PDF (chop etish ixtiyoriy).
Kahoot: 'O'tgan dars Kahooti' tugmasi (3-dars savollari).
Speaking kartochkalari (class_ex SPEAKING) — proyektor yoki juftlikka 1 varaq.
Writing savoli + namuna kirish va Body 1 (class_ex WRITING) — proyektor.
Reading matni — proyektor yoki chop etilgan nusxa.
Listening transcript — faqat ustoz ekranida (o'quvchiga ko'rsatilmaydi).
Rubrikalar: W-4.0 + W-CHECK-4.0 — class_ex dagi jadval (proyektor); S-4.0 — speaking feedback uchun.
timeline: Salomlashish + kirish savoli

Lead-in: ustoz doskaga yozadi — 'The train leaves at 9. I'm meeting the boss at 10. I'm about to send my CV.' va so'raydi: 'What are you doing this weekend?' 3–4 o'quvchi javob beradi; ishlatilgan shakllar doskada qoladi.
TAKROR: Kahoot — 3-dars (Modal verbs: ought to, be able to)
'O'tgan dars Kahooti' tugmasi → 3-dars savollari (20 ta). Bugungi darsning Kahooti bu yerda EMAS — u 5-darsda o'ynaladi. Oxirgi 1 daqiqa: eng ko'p xato qilingan 2 savol izohi.
TAKROR: Yozma normativ — Essential Words 3 (Technology and innovation)

Normativ — belgilangan vaqtda bajariladigan qisqa o'lchov; natijasiga qarab coin beriladi. 3-dars CORE 20: ustoz o'zbekchasini aytadi, o'quvchi inglizchasini yozadi — 4 daq; 1 daq sherik bilan almashib tekshirish. 18–20 = 2 coin; 15–17 = bajarildi; 14 va kam = 5-darsda qayta topshiradi.
Uy vazifasi tekshiruvi

Tarjima kaliti proyektorda (1 daq, o'quvchi o'zi belgilaydi). Yozma ishlar yig'ib olinadi (W-4.0 bo'yicha keyingi darsgacha tekshiriladi); eng ko'p uchragan 2 xato doskada (2 daq). Bajarmaganlar jurnalga.
YANGI GRAMMATIKA — Kelajakning boshqa shakllari + CCQ

Lead-in misoli (kirishdagi 3 gap) → formula (proyektor, grammar.formulas 1–7) → 2–3 misol (grammar.formulas + grammar.presentation) → CCQ (presentation dagi CCQ qatorlari) → 1 daqiqalik tez og'zaki tekshiruv: ustoz vaziyatni aytadi ('jadval', 'bir daqiqadan keyin', 'rasmiy yangilik', 'deyarli aniq'), o'quvchilar shaklni aytadi. Oxirida will bilan taqqoslash (grammar.notes).
LUG'AT — Essential Words 4 CORE 20

Ustoz 20 so'zni proyektorda talaffuz + tarjima bilan o'qitadi (3 daq); 6–8 ta qiyin so'zga CCQ yoki misol (3 daq) — burnout, workload, self-employed, overtime, commute, recruitment; juftlikda A o'zbekchasini, B inglizchasini aytadi (2 daq). Mustahkamlash — flashcard (uyga).
Kombinatsiya — S + be going to / about to / due to / likely to + V1

Kombinatsiya — juftlikda formula → gap → tarjima zanjiri: A formulani yoki o'zbekcha gapni aytadi, B shu formula bilan inglizcha gap tuzib tarjima qiladi, keyin almashadi. 1 daq — ustoz grammar.formulas dan formulani va 1 misolni proyektorda ko'rsatadi; 3 daq — juftlikda (me'yor normativ[1] da); ustoz 2 juftlikni tinglaydi.
SINF MASHQLARI — Ex1–Ex4 (MAJBURIY) + ZAXIRA

Ex1 5 daq yakka (shaklni tanlash) · Ex2 4 daq juftlik (qaysi biri tabiiyroq va nega) · Ex3 4 daq yakka (lug'at + kelajak shakli) · Ex4 4 daq juftlik (paragrafdagi 5 xato). 3 daqiqa WRITING bosqichiga berildi; ZAXIRA (reading'ning 'find' topshirig'i) uyga o'tadi.
SPEAKING — Part 2 + Part 3

class_ex SPEAKING, juftlikda: 1 daq — kartochkalar proyektorda + ICQ; 1 daq — tayyorgarlik; 2 daq — A gapiradi (kartochka A), B checklist to'ldiradi; 2 daq — B gapiradi (kartochka B); 3 daq — Part 3 savollari; 1 daq — ustoz 1 ta umumiy feedback (S-4.0).
READING — Kylian Mbappé
1 daq — gist (1-topshiriq, sarlavhalar); 7 daq — o'qish + TFNG; 3 daq — completion; 2 daq — tekshirish, NOT GIVEN izohi. Yakka ishlanadi, tekshirish juftlikda.
LISTENING — IELTS Part 4
1 daq — savollarni o'qish; 1-tinglash (3 daq); 2-tinglash (3 daq); 1 daq — javoblar proyektorda. Ustoz listening.transcript dagi ma'ruzani o'qiydi; yakka ishlanadi.
WRITING — Working longer hours

class_ex WRITING (Task 2, causes + effects): 3 daq — savol tahlili (savol turi: causes + effects, kalit so'zlar, pozitsiya, 2 body: Body 1 — sabablar, Body 2 — oqibatlar: shaxsga va jamiyatga) · 5 daq — NAMUNA kirish + Body 1 tahlili (box, proyektorda: topic sentence, bog'lovchilar, be about to, EW so'zlari overtime / career) · 5 daq — yakka Body 2 (60–80 so'z, is likely to / is bound to / is going to dan 2 tasi) · 2 daq — sherik W-CHECK-4.0 bilan tekshiradi. To'liq insho — uyga (40 daq).
Xatolar ustida ishlash + uyga vazifa

4 daq — dars davomida ustoz yozib borgan 4–5 ta og'zaki/yozma xato doskada, o'quvchilar tuzatadi (error log); 3 daq — uyga vazifa: 1–4 majburiy (4 — WRITING: to'liq insho, 40 daq), 5–6 qo'shimcha; insho savoli proyektorda; 5-darsda shu savol bo'yicha WRITING NORMATIV bo'lishini e'lon qiling. Vaqt yetmasa: reading'ning 'find' topshirig'i uyga o'tadi.

intro: BE GOING TO — oldindan reja yoki dalilli bashorat; PRESENT CONTINUOUS — kelishilgan reja (vaqt/joy aniq); PRESENT SIMPLE — jadval (transport, dars).
BE ABOUT TO — juda yaqin (hozir-hozir); BE DUE TO — belgilangan vaqt; BE TO — rasmiy reja/buyruq; BE SET TO — rasmiy, yangiliklar.
BE BOUND/SURE/CERTAIN TO — yuqori ishonch; BE LIKELY/UNLIKELY TO — ehtimol (Writing'da ko'p).
formulas: be going to
S + am/is/are going to + V1
It's going to rain soon. / I'm going to apply for the job.
Tez orada yomg'ir yog'adi. / Ishga ariza beraman (rejam).
Present Continuous
S + am/is/are + V-ing (+ vaqt)
We're meeting them at 6 p.m.
Biz ular bilan soat 6 da uchrashamiz.
Present Simple
S + V(s) (jadval)
The train leaves at 9 a.m.
Poyezd soat 9 da jo'naydi.
be about to / be due to
S + be about to + V1 / S + be due to + V1
She is about to leave. / The meeting is due to start at 10.
U hozir ketmoqchi. / Yig'ilish 10 da boshlanishi belgilangan.
be to
S + am/is/are to + V1 (rasmiy)
The President is to visit tomorrow.
Prezident ertaga tashrif buyuradi.
be set to / be expected to (rasmiy, yangiliklar, Task 1)
S + am/is/are set to + V1; S + am/is/are expected to + V1
Fuel prices are set to rise next month. / Sales are expected to grow by 10%.
Yoqilg'i narxi kelasi oy oshishi kutilmoqda (deyarli aniq). / Savdo 10% ga o'sishi kutilmoqda.
be bound / likely to
S + be bound/sure/certain to + V1; S + be likely/unlikely to + V1
He is bound to succeed. / They are likely to win the match.
U albatta muvaffaqiyatga erishadi. / Ular o'yinda yutishi ehtimoli katta.
presentation: What are you going to do after IELTS 4.0?
I'm going to apply for a scholarship abroad.
Are you meeting anyone about a job?
Yes, I'm meeting a recruiter on Friday.
When does the interview start?
It starts at 10; I'm about to leave now.
Is the new office due to open soon?
It's due to open in September.
Are fuel prices set to rise?
Yes, the news says they are set to rise next month.
Are working hours likely to get longer?
Yes, they are likely to — and burnout is bound to increase.
Is unemployment likely to fall next year?
It is unlikely to fall quickly.
CCQ: I'm meeting the boss at 10 tomorrow.
Is it arranged? (Yes) Do we know the time? (Yes, 10)
CCQ: She is about to leave.
Is she still here? (Yes) Will she leave very soon? (Yes, in a minute)
CCQ: The meeting is due to start at 10.
Is the time planned? (Yes) Has it started? (No)
CCQ: He is bound to pass the exam.
Is the speaker sure? (Yes, very) Is it a fact now? (No, a strong prediction)
CCQ: The President is to visit Samarkand.
Is it official news? (Yes) Is it the speaker's personal plan? (No)
notes: will — o'sha paytdagi qaror/va'da/bashorat; be going to — oldindan reja; Present Continuous — kelishilgan (vaqt/joy aniq).
be to — yangiliklar va rasmiy hujjatlar; buyruq: "You are to be here at 8."

O'quvchi so'raydi: 'I'm meeting him' va 'I'm going to meet him' farqi bormi? — Javob: ikkalasi ham to'g'ri; Present Continuous — vaqt/joy kelishilgan (kalendarda bor), be going to — niyat, hali kelishilmagan bo'lishi mumkin.
O'quvchi so'raydi: be bound to va be likely to farqi nima? — Javob: bound to — so'zlovchi deyarli ishonch hosil qilgan; likely to — ehtimoli katta, lekin kafolat yo'q.
O'quvchi so'raydi: 'The train will leave at 9' xatomi? — Javob: xato emas, lekin jadval (transport, dars) uchun Present Simple tabiiyroq: The train leaves at 9.
mistakes: I'm going to meeting him tomorrow.
I'm going to meet him tomorrow.
The meeting is due start at 10.
The meeting is due to start at 10.
Prices are set rise next year.
Prices are set to rise next year.

how: CORE 20 — ish va karyera asoslari (career, promotion, workload…); STRONG — ish bozori va shartlar (recruitment, redundancy, internship); SUPER — Task 1/Task 2 kollokatsiyalari (climb the career ladder, earn a living, job prospects).
Misolda so'zning o'zi albatta bo'ladi, gap tabiiy va faktik to'g'ri; bugungi grammatika qolipi — ixtiyoriy, faqat tabiiy tushsa.
core: I'm going to build a career in engineering.
She is likely to get a promotion next year.
U kelasi yil lavozim ko'tarilishi ehtimol.
The workload is bound to increase in December.
Work-life balance is unlikely to improve without limits.
Cheklovlarsiz ish-hayot muvozanati yaxshilanishi ehtimoldan yiroq.
Employees who work 60 hours a week are likely to suffer burnout.
Haftasiga 60 soat ishlaydigan xodimlar holdan toyishi ehtimol.
Recruitment is due to start in March.
Salaries are likely to rise with inflation.
The company is about to introduce flexible hours.
Kompaniya moslashuvchan ish vaqtini joriy etmoqchi.
Overtime is unlikely to be paid.
Qo'shimcha ish vaqti to'lanishi ehtimoldan yiroq.
Job satisfaction is likely to fall if working hours get longer.
Ish soatlari uzaysa, ishdan qoniqish pasayishi ehtimol.
The employer is to pay all employees by the 5th of each month.
Ish beruvchi barcha xodimlarga har oyning 5-sanasigacha haq to'lashi kerak.
Unemployment is likely to fall slowly.
Our workplace is going to move to a new building in May.
Ish joyimiz may oyida yangi binoga ko'chadi.
I'm about to send my CV.
The interview is due to start at ten.
I'm about to sign my first work contract.
Men birinchi mehnat shartnomamni imzolash arafasidaman.

Productivity is likely to drop after ten hours of work.
O'n soatlik ishdan keyin samaradorlik pasayishi ehtimol.
The new metro line is going to cut my commute to twenty minutes.
Yangi metro liniyasi ishga qatnovimni yigirma daqiqagacha qisqartiradi.
strong: Redundancies are likely if the company merges.

Tez-tez kech qoladigan xodimlar ishdan bo'shatilishi ehtimol.
She is going to do an apprenticeship.
The internship is due to end in August.
A vacancy is about to be advertised.
Bo'sh ish o'rni hozir e'lon qilinmoqchi.
Fifty candidates are to be interviewed.
Shift work is likely to harm sleep.
Smenali ish uyquga zarar berishi ehtimol.
The report is due on Friday — we can't miss the deadline.
Hisobot juma kuni topshirilishi kerak — muddatni o'tkazib yubora olmaymiz.
In a big project, teamwork is likely to matter more than talent.
Katta loyihada jamoaviy ish iste'doddan ko'ra muhimroq bo'lishi ehtimol.
Leadership training is due to start next term.
Yetakchilik treningi kelasi chorakda boshlanishi belgilangan.
The labour market is unlikely to recover quickly.
Mehnat bozori tez tiklanishi ehtimoldan yiroq.
The minimum wage is to rise in January.
Pensions are likely to be smaller for our generation.
Bizning avlod uchun pensiya kichikroq bo'lishi ehtimol.
Job security is going to matter more than salary.
Ish kafolati oylikdan ko'ra muhimroq bo'ladi.
The company is about to cut perks.
I'm going to be an entrepreneur, not an employee.
The transfer is due to be completed on Monday.
His ambition is bound to take him to the top.
Uning katta maqsadi uni albatta cho'qqiga olib chiqadi.
super: With such small pensions, few people are likely to take early retirement.
Pensiya bunchalik kichik bo'lsa, kam odam muddatidan oldin nafaqaga chiqishi ehtimol.
She is bound to climb the career ladder fast.
U karyera zinasidan albatta tez ko'tariladi.
Long working hours are likely to damage health.
Uzoq ish soatlari sog'liqqa zarar berishi ehtimol.
The job market is about to change because of AI.
AI tufayli ish bozori o'zgarish arafasida.
A strong work ethic is likely to impress employers.

class_ex.title: SPEAKING — Part 2: Future jobs and plans
class_ex.instr: (10 daq, juftlik) 1 daq — ustoz kartochkani proyektorda ko'rsatadi, ICQ: Necha daqiqa tayyorlanasiz? (1) Kim birinchi? (A). 1 daq — tayyorgarlik (faqat 5–6 kalit so'z yoziladi). 2 daq — A gapiradi, B sherik checklist'ini to'ldiradi. 2 daq — B boshqa kartochka bo'yicha gapiradi. 3 daq — juftlikda Part 3 savollari. 1 daq — ustoz 1 ta umumiy feedback (S-4.0 bo'yicha).
items: KARTOCHKA A: Describe a job you would like to do in the future. You should say: what the job is ; why you are interested in it ; what skills or qualifications you need ; and explain how you are going to prepare for it.

KARTOCHKA B: Describe your plans for the next year. You should say: what you are going to do ; when and where you are going to do it ; who is going to help you ; and explain why these plans are important to you.
Part 3: Is it better to have one job for life or change jobs often?
Part 3: Are people likely to work from home more in the future?
Part 3: What skills will be important in ten years?
answers: NAMUNA A (faqat ustoz uchun, Band 5.5–6, 120–160 so'z): I'd like to talk about a job I'm hoping to do in the future — a software developer. I became interested in it two years ago, when I made a simple website for my uncle's shop. For this job you need good maths, English and a lot of patience. My plan is clear: I'm going to finish school next year, and then I'm applying to an IT university — the entrance exam is due to take place in July. To prepare, I'm taking an online coding course this summer, and I'm going to build a small app for my school. This job is likely to give me a good salary and flexible hours. But the main reason is that I enjoy solving problems, and when my code finally works, I feel really proud.

NAMUNA B (120–160 so'z): Next year is going to be a busy year for me. First, I'm taking the IELTS exam in March, so I'm studying every evening now. My English teacher is helping me with speaking practice every Saturday, and my older cousin is going to help me write my first CV. I'm also hoping to save some money for a laptop. After that, I'm hoping to find a part-time job, maybe in a café, because I want to gain work experience. In the summer my family and I are visiting our relatives in Samarkand — we've already bought the train tickets. School, IELTS and work together are bound to be tiring, but this year is likely to be very important for my future, because it will show me what I can really do.

Part 3 namuna: 1) Changing jobs teaches new skills, but one job for life gives more security. 2) Yes, in IT and office jobs, but doctors or builders are unlikely to. 3) Digital skills are bound to be important, and so are teamwork and communication.
class_ex.note: Sherik checklist: 4 ta you should say bandi aytildimi? Bugungi struktura 1–2 marta? Bugungi CORE'dan 2 so'z? 1.5 daqiqadan uzoq gapirdimi? Ustoz har darsda 3–4 o'quvchini S-4.0 rubrikasi bo'yicha jurnalga qayd etadi.

class_ex.title: WRITING — Working longer hours (yozma): Task 2 insho — tahlil va Body 2
class_ex.instr: (15 daq) 3 daq — savol tahlili (juftlikda 1–2-savollar). 5 daq — namuna kirish va Body 1 ni proyektorda o'qing, 3–5-savollarga javob bering. 5 daq — yakka Body 2 (60–80 so'z): oqibatlar — shaxsga VA jamiyatga. 2 daq — sherik bilan almashib, W-CHECK-4.0 bo'yicha Ha/Yo'q belgilang. ICQ: Body 2 da nima yozasiz — sabablarmi yoki oqibatlarmi? (oqibatlar: shaxsga va jamiyatga) Necha so'z? (60–80)
box: Question: Many people are working longer hours. What are the causes of this, and what effects does it have on individuals and society?

MODEL — Introduction: These days, many people spend far more time at work than their parents did. In my opinion, this trend is caused mainly by financial pressure and modern technology, and its effects on both individuals and society are largely negative.

MODEL — Body 1: There are two main reasons for this situation. Firstly, prices are rising faster than incomes, so many people do overtime or take a second job just to pay for rent, food and their children's education. For example, in Tashkent many school teachers give private lessons every evening after a full day at school. Secondly, smartphones and messaging apps mean that work never really stops. A manager can send a task late at night, and many people answer it even when they are about to go to bed, because they are afraid of damaging their career.
items: 1) Savol turi qanday (opinion / causes + effects / advantages + disadvantages)? Savolda nechta qism bor?
2) Kalit so'zlar: working longer hours, causes, effects, individuals, society. Nechta body kerak va har birida nima bo'ladi?
3) Pozitsiya qaysi gapda? Kirish savolni qanday parafraz qilgan (2 misol)?
4) Bugungi grammatika qayerda? Body 2 (oqibatlar) da qaysi kelajak shakllari kerak bo'ladi va nega?
5) Qaysi Essential Words 4 (Work) so'zlari ishlatilgan? Body 2 uchun yana qaysilari mos?
TASK: Write Body 2 (60–80 words): Topic sentence -> Explain -> Example -> Link. Write about effects on individuals AND on society. Use 2 of: is likely to / is bound to / is going to.
answers: Tahlil kaliti: 1) Causes + effects — 2 qism: sabablar VA oqibatlar (oqibatlar ikki tomonlama: shaxsga va jamiyatga). 2) 2 body: Body 1 — 2 sabab (pul, texnologiya), Body 2 — oqibatlar (shaxs: stress, burnout, oila; jamiyat: unumdorlik, sog'liqni saqlash). 3) Pozitsiya — kirishning 2-gapi ('In my opinion, … largely negative'). Parafraz: 'are working longer hours' -> 'spend far more time at work'; 'what effects does it have' -> 'its effects … are largely negative'. 4) Body 1 da: 'when they are about to go to bed' (be about to). Body 2 da kelajakdagi natija bashorat qilinadi: is likely to (ehtimoli katta), is bound to (deyarli aniq). 5) Body 1: overtime, career. Body 2 va xulosa uchun: workload, burnout, productivity, work-life balance.

NAMUNA Body 2 + Conclusion (faqat ustoz uchun): These long hours have serious effects on both individuals and society. For individuals, a heavy workload is likely to cause stress and burnout, and people have less time for sleep, sport and their families. For instance, a father who comes home at nine o'clock rarely has the energy to help his children with homework. For society, tired workers make more mistakes, so overall productivity is bound to fall, and hospitals have to treat more stress-related illnesses. In conclusion, people work longer hours mainly because of money problems and constant online contact. Unless companies and the government protect work-life balance, this problem will only get worse, so reasonable working hours should become a priority for everyone.
To'liq namuna: 250 so'z (kirish 39, Body 1 95, Body 2 77, xulosa 39).
why: 'when they are about to go to bed' — be about to + V1: hozir-hozir bo'ladigan ish (yotishga chog'lanib turgan payt).
'a heavy workload is likely to cause stress' — is likely to + V1: ehtimoli katta oqibat; IELTS da 'will' dan ehtiyotkorroq bashorat.
'overall productivity is bound to fall' — is bound to + V1: mantiqan deyarli muqarrar natija.

EW 4 so'zlari: overtime (qo'shimcha ish soatlari), career (karyera), workload (ish yuki), burnout (haddan tashqari charchab 'yonib' qolish), productivity (unumdorlik), work-life balance (ish va shaxsiy hayot muvozanati).
O'zbek misoli: Toshkentdagi maktab o'qituvchisi kechqurun xususiy dars beradi — aniq va tanish misol TR ballini oshiradi.
class_ex.note: Manba: Kitob IELTS 4.0, SAMPLE ESSAYS, Topic 9 — faqat savol olindi; namuna insho Jony Academy original matni. Kuchsiz: Body 2 uchun topic sentence ni ustoz doskaga yozib beradi; Kuchli: 80 so'zgacha + 3 xil kelajak shakli.

class_ex.instr: Proyektorda yoki ustoz ekranida: Body 2 va uydagi insho shu jadval bilan baholanadi (4 mezon × 0–3 = 12 ball).

rows: Vazifaga javob (TR; Task 1 da TA)

Savolning BARCHA qismiga javob (sabab VA yechim; ikki fikr VA o'z fikri; ijobiy VA salbiy tomon); pozitsiya kirishda aniq va xulosagacha saqlanadi; har asosiy g'oya izoh va aniq misol bilan. Insho: kirish + 2 body + xulosa, 220–260 so'z; paragraf: talab qilingan so'z soni. Task 1: overview bor, asosiy raqamlar to'g'ri.
Savolga javob va pozitsiya bor, lekin bir qismi yuzaki yoki misol umumiy; insho 180–219 so'z yoki xulosa 1 gapdan iborat. Task 1: overview bor, ayrim raqamlar keraksiz.
Savolning faqat bir qismiga javob (masalan, faqat sabablar); pozitsiya noaniq yoki o'zgarib ketadi; g'oyalar takrorlanadi; insho 120–179 so'z. Task 1: overview yo'q.
Savolga javob yo'q, mavzudan tashqari, yodlangan boshqa matn yoki so'z soni talabning yarmidan kam.
Izchillik va bog'lanish (CC)

Abzatslar aniq: kirish -> Body 1 -> Body 2 -> xulosa; har body: topic sentence -> izoh -> misol -> link; 4+ xil bog'lovchi to'g'ri (however, as a result, for example, on the other hand); ishora so'zlari (this, they, such) to'g'ri.
Abzatslar bor, mantiq tushunarli; 2–3 bog'lovchi, ba'zan mexanik (Firstly, Secondly…); 1–2 noaniq ishora.
Abzatsga bo'linmagan yoki body da topic sentence yo'q; bog'lovchilar 1–2 ta yoki noto'g'ri.
G'oyalar tartibsiz, bog'lanish yo'q.
Lug'at boyligi (LR)
Shu darsning Essential Words so'zlaridan 4+ ta va 2+ kollokatsiya to'g'ri; savol so'zlari parafraz qilingan; imlo xatosi 1–2 ta.
Mavzu so'zlari bor, lekin takror ko'p yoki 3–4 so'z noto'g'ri tanlangan; savol so'zlari ko'chirilgan; imlo xatolari ma'noga xalaqit bermaydi.
Oddiy, takroriy lug'at; so'z tanlash va imlo xatolari ma'noni qiyinlashtiradi.
Juda cheklangan lug'at, ma'no tushunarsiz.
Grammatika aniqligi va xilma-xilligi (GRA)
Sodda va qo'shma gaplar aralash (because, although, which, if); bugungi struktura 1–3 marta to'g'ri va tabiiy; gaplarning ko'pi xatosiz.
Qo'shma gap urinishlari bor; xatolar bor, lekin ma'no tushunarli; artikl/zamon xatolari takrorlanadi.
Asosan sodda gaplar; xatolar ko'p, ayrim gaplar tushunarsiz.
Gap tuzilishi deyarli yo'q.
Jami (12 ball) -> taxminiy band
11–12 ball ≈ Band 5.5–6
8–10 ball ≈ Band 5
5–7 ball ≈ Band 4–4.5
0–4 ball ≈ Band 3.5 va past
Qoidalar (ustoz uchun)
Vaqt: insho 40 daq (uyda, taymer), WRITING NORMATIV 10 daq; vaqt tugaganda chiziq tortiladi, chiziqdan keyingi qism baholanmaydi.
So'z sonini o'quvchi oxirida yozadi; ustoz 2 qatorni sanab tekshiradi; insho 180 so'zdan kam — TR ko'pi bilan 1.
Namuna yoki boshqa manbadan ko'chirilgani aniqlansa — 0 ball, sinfda boshqa savol bilan qayta yozadi.
Ustoz har ish chetiga TR/CC/LR/GRA ballarini va 1 ta eng muhim tuzatishni yozadi; umumiy 2–3 xato keyingi darsning 'Xatolar ustida ishlash' bosqichiga.

reading.title: Kylian Mbappé — a career that was bound to be special
text: A. Kylian Mbappé was born in December 1998 and grew up in Bondy, a suburb of Paris. His father was a football coach and his mother a former handball player, so his future was likely to be in sport from the start. As a boy he spent hours at the local club, and by his early teens several top European clubs wanted to sign him. As a young teenager he was even invited to visit Real Madrid.

B. However, he decided to join Monaco, partly because young players there were more likely to get a chance in the first team. At just 16 he played his first match for the club. In 2017 he moved to Paris Saint-Germain for a fee of around 180 million euros, one of the highest ever paid for a footballer. A year later, at 19, he scored in the World Cup final and became the first teenager since Pelé to do so.

C. After that final, journalists wrote that he was bound to become one of the best players in the world. Speed and talent were only part of the story. Mbappé is known for a strong work ethic and a serious attitude to training, rest and diet. Many young players now see him as an example of how much hard work a top career needs.

D. In 2024, after seven years in Paris, he joined Real Madrid as a free agent. For years many fans had expected this move, and it finally happened on his own terms. His contract is to run until 2029, so he is likely to spend some of the best years of his career in Spain.

E. Off the pitch, he is likely to be remembered for more than goals. He is reported to give his earnings from the French national team to charity, and his foundation helps young people follow their dreams. His story shows that talent gets you noticed, but hard work is what keeps you at the top.
(Jony Academy tomonidan o'quv maqsadida yozilgan matn.)
glossary: free agent — shartnomasi tugagan, bepul o'ta oladigan o'yinchi
on one's own terms — o'z shartlari bilan

listening.audios: Jony Academy skripti — ustoz 2 marta o'qiydi (audio fayl yo'q; kitobdagi Audio 16–20 bu darsda ishlatilmaydi).
intro: You will hear part of a lecture about a trial of shorter working weeks in a group of small companies.
1-tinglash: bo'shliqlarni to'ldiring; 2-tinglash: javoblarni tekshiring.
Write ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.

tasks.title: Note completion — ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER
tasks.instr: Ma'ruza bo'yicha 7 ta bo'shliqni to'ldiring.
items: Usual working week before the trial: ___ hours
Days worked per week during the trial: ___
The trial finished in: ___
Productivity: stayed the ___
Sick days: fell by about a ___
Problem: customers could not contact staff on ___
Final report: will be published in ___

transcript: USTOZ UCHUN: 2 marta o'qing; monolog (IELTS Part 4 — ma'ruza), ustoz o'qiydi, raqamlarni aniq ayting.
Lecturer: Good morning. Today's lecture is about working hours and what is likely to happen to them in the next ten years.
Lecturer: Let's start with a trial in a group of small companies. Before the trial, staff usually worked forty hours a week — sorry, forty-two, because most people stayed late on Fridays.
Lecturer: During the trial, they worked four days instead of five, but they kept the same salary.
Lecturer: The trial was due to finish in March, but in the end it continued until June, because managers wanted more data.
Lecturer: So what happened? Many people expected productivity to fall. In fact, it stayed the same, and the number of sick days dropped by about a third.

Lecturer: Not everything was positive, though. Some customers complained that they couldn't contact anyone on Fridays, so several companies are about to introduce a rota — a timetable where staff take turns.
Lecturer: Most managers say they are going to keep the four-day week. However, these companies are small, so the results are unlikely to be the same in a large hospital or factory.
Lecturer: The final report is due to be published in September — not August, as I said last week. Next time we'll look at working from home.

kahoot.q: Look at those dark clouds! It ___ rain.
kahoot.explain: Hozirgi dalilga (bulut) asoslangan bashorat → be going to.

kahoot.q: The train ___ at 9 a.m. every day.
kahoot.explain: Jadval (poyezd, dars) → Present Simple: The train leaves at 9.

kahoot.q: I ___ my boss at 10 tomorrow — it's in my calendar.
kahoot.explain: Vaqti kelishilgan reja → Present Continuous: I'm meeting.

kahoot.q: Hurry up! The film ___ start.
kahoot.explain: be about TO + V1 = hozir-hozir bo'ladi.

kahoot.q: The meeting ___ start at 10 a.m.
kahoot.explain: be due TO + V1 = belgilangan vaqtda bo'ladi.

kahoot.q: The President ___ visit Samarkand next week. (rasmiy yangilik)
kahoot.explain: Rasmiy reja (yangiliklar) → be to + V1: is to visit.

kahoot.q: He trains every single day. He ___ succeed.
kahoot.explain: be bound to + V1 = albatta bo'ladi (katta ishonch).

kahoot.q: Qaysi gapda XATO bor?
kahoot.explain: be likely TO + V1: He is likely to succeed.

kahoot.q: News: Fuel prices ___ rise next month.
kahoot.explain: be set to + V1 — rasmiy/yangilik uslubi: deyarli aniq kelajak.

kahoot.q: It is unlikely ___ tomorrow.
kahoot.explain: be (un)likely TO + V1: unlikely to snow.

kahoot.q: I've decided: I ___ for an internship this summer.
kahoot.explain: Oldindan qilingan qaror/reja → be going to + V1: I am going to apply.

kahoot.q: Writing Task 1: Sales are expected ___ by 20% next year.
kahoot.explain: be expected TO + V1: are expected to rise.

kahoot.q: Working too hard for too long can cause ___.
kahoot.explain: burnout = holdan toyish (ruhiy va jismoniy).

kahoot.q: She got a ___ and is now the manager.
kahoot.explain: promotion = lavozim ko'tarilishi.

kahoot.q: A healthy balance between your job and personal life is ___.
kahoot.explain: work-life balance = ish va shaxsiy hayot muvozanati.

kahoot.q: He has no boss — he works for himself. He is ___.
kahoot.explain: self-employed = o'zi uchun ishlaydi. unemployed = ishsiz.

kahoot.q: There is a ___ for an English teacher at our school — apply now!
kahoot.explain: vacancy = bo'sh ish o'rni.

kahoot.q: Many students do ___ at companies to get work experience.
kahoot.explain: internship = amaliyot (stajirovka).

kahoot.q: The ___ pays the salary; the employee does the work.
kahoot.explain: employer = ish beruvchi; employee = xodim.

kahoot.q: "muddat" (ishni topshirish muddati) — inglizcha?
kahoot.explain: deadline = oxirgi muddat; headline = sarlavha.

lessons.title: Adverbial Phrases
lessons.grammar_topic: RAVISH IBORALARI — vaqt, joy, tarz, sabab, maqsad, takrorlik, daraja, shart, yon berish (in the morning / with great care / because of / in order to / despite…)
lessons.vocab_topic: Essential Words 5 — Health and lifestyle (sog'liq va turmush tarzi)
lessons.test_after: PROGRESS TEST 1 (pt1) — 6-dars boshida, 40 daqiqa; qamrov 1–5-darslar (prefixes, suffixes, ought to / be able to, future forms, adverbial phrases; Essential Words 1–5; reading, listening, writing paragraf)
lessons.book_ref: Student's book IELTS 4.0: Lesson 5 – Adverbial phrases (ixtiyoriy; dars kitobsiz o'tadi). Kitob audiolari ishlatilmaydi; listening — Jony Academy skripti. Reading — Novak Djokovic (Jony Academy matni). Speaking: Kitob SAMPLE SPEAKING, Topic: Weather — faqat mavzu; namunalar original. Writing: Kitob SAMPLE ESSAYS, Topic 9 — faqat savol (4-dars inshosi savoli, WRITING NORMATIV); namuna original.
objectives: Dars oxirida o'quvchi 9 turdagi ravish iborasini savol so'zi (qachon? qayerda? qanday? nega? nima uchun? qancha tez-tez? qay darajada? qanday holatda? …ga qaramay?) bo'yicha aniqlaydi va Ex1 da 8 gapdan kamida 6 tasini to'g'ri to'ldiradi.
Dars oxirida o'quvchi because of / due to / despite + ot (V-ing) va in order to + V1 shaklini to'g'ri tanlab, ergash gapni iboraga aylantiradi (Ex2 — 5 gapdan kamida 4 tasi).

Dars oxirida o'quvchi Weather mavzusida Part 1 savollariga 2–3 gapdan javob beradi va Kartochka A (favourite season) bo'yicha 1.5 daqiqa, box'dagi 2+ ibora va 1–2 ravish iborasi bilan gapiradi (S-CHECK-4.0 ning 5 bandidan kamida 4 tasi).
Dars oxirida o'quvchi 'Working longer hours' savoliga 9 daqiqada, namunasiz kirish + 1 body (110–140 so'z) yozadi va W-CHECK-4.0 ning 7 bandidan kamida 5 tasini bajaradi (WRITING NORMATIV).

timeline: Salomlashish + kirish savoli

Kirish savoli: 'What do you do to stay healthy during exams?' — 2–3 javob (1 daq). Ustoz gapni kengaytiradi: 'Djokovic trains.' → '…hard → on the court → every morning → in order to win → despite injuries'; o'quvchilar har iboraning turini aytadi (3 daq).
TAKROR: Kahoot — 4-dars (Other ways of referring to the future)
'O'tgan dars Kahooti' tugmasi → 4-dars savollari (20 ta). Bugungi darsning Kahooti bu yerda EMAS — u 6-darsda o'ynaladi. Oxirgi 1 daqiqa: eng ko'p xato qilingan 2 savol izohi.
TAKROR: Yozma normativ — Essential Words 4 (Work and careers)

Normativ — belgilangan vaqtda bajariladigan qisqa o'lchov; natijasiga qarab coin beriladi. 4-dars CORE 20: ustoz o'zbekchasini aytadi, o'quvchi inglizchasini yozadi — 4 daq; 1 daq sherik bilan almashib tekshirish. 18–20 = 2 coin; 15–17 = bajarildi; 14 va kam = 6-darsda qayta topshiradi.
Uy vazifasi tekshiruvi

Tarjima kaliti proyektorda (1 daq, o'quvchi o'zi belgilaydi). 4-dars inshosi (WRITING — Working longer hours: to'liq insho) yig'ib olinadi — W-4.0 bilan keyingi darsgacha baholanadi; eng ko'p uchragan 2 xato doskada (2 daq). Bajarmaganlar jurnalga.
YANGI GRAMMATIKA — Ravish iboralari (9 tur) + CCQ

Lead-in: 'Despite the war, he kept training.' — qaysi qism '…ga qaramay?' ga javob? (2 daq) → formula (proyektor, grammar.formulas 1–6): 9 tur, + ot / + V1, tartib tarz → joy → vaqt (7 daq) → 2–3 misol: presentation savol-javoblari, juftlikda (4 daq) → 4 ta CCQ (3 daq) → tez og'zaki tekshiruv: ustoz 'because it rained' deydi, o'quvchi 'because of the rain' (2 daq).
LUG'AT — Essential Words 5 CORE 20

Ustoz 20 so'zni proyektorda talaffuz + tarjima bilan o'qitadi (3 daq); 6–8 ta qiyin so'zga CCQ yoki misol (3 daq); juftlikda A o'zbekchasini, B inglizchasini aytadi (2 daq). Mustahkamlash — flashcard (uyga).
Kombinatsiya — because of / due to / despite + ot; in order to + V1

Kombinatsiya — juftlikda formula → gap → tarjima zanjiri: A formulani yoki o'zbekcha gapni aytadi, B shu formula bilan inglizcha gap tuzib tarjima qiladi, keyin almashadi. 1 daq — ustoz grammar.formulas dan formulani va 1 misolni proyektorda ko'rsatadi; 3 daq — juftlikda (me'yor normativ[1] da); ustoz 2 juftlikni tinglaydi.

Ex1 5 daq yakka (bo'shliq) · Ex2 5 daq juftlik (ergash gap → ibora) · Ex3 5 daq juftlik (lug'at + ibora) · Ex4 3 daq yakka (paragrafdagi 5 xato; kuchsiz o'quvchi faqat xatoli so'z tagiga chizadi); kalit proyektorda. ZAXIRA (reading 4-topshirig'i) uyga o'tadi — bo'shagan 2 daqiqa SPEAKING ga berildi.

class_ex WRITING NORMATIV (4-dars inshosi savoli): 1' savol va qoida · 9' yakka kirish + 1 body (110–140 so'z) — daftar, telefon, namunasiz · 2' W-CHECK-4.0 bilan o'zini tekshirish, so'z soni oxirida yoziladi, ish yig'iladi (W-4.0 bilan keyingi darsgacha baholanadi).
Xatolar ustida ishlash + uyga vazifa

4 daq — dars davomida ustoz yozib borgan 4–5 ta og'zaki/yozma xato doskada, o'quvchilar tuzatadi (error log); 3 daq — uyga vazifa: 1–4 majburiy (4 — SPEAKING NORMATIV, Kartochka B proyektorda), 5–6 qo'shimcha. Vaqt yetmasa: ZAXIRA mashqlar va reading'ning 'find' topshirig'i uyga o'tadi.

intro: VAQT: in the morning, at the moment, after the match. JOY: at school, in the city centre, on the court.
TARZ: with great care, in a hurry, like a professional. SABAB: because of / due to / thanks to + ot.
MAQSAD: in order to / so as to + V1, for + ot. TAKRORLIK: every week, once in a while, twice a day.
DARAJA: to a great extent, to some degree. SHART / HOLAT: in case of fire, in the event of…, under pressure (holat)
YON BERISH: despite / in spite of + ot/V-ing (despite the difficulty, despite being injured).
IBORA O'RNI: odatda gap oxirida (tarz → joy → vaqt); urg'u uchun boshida, uzunroq iboradan keyin vergul.
formulas: Vaqt / Joy
in the morning, at the moment, before lunch / at school, in the city centre, on the roof
He trains at the club in the morning.
U ertalab klubda mashq qiladi.
Tarz
with great care, in a hurry, like a professional
She plays like a professional.
U professionaldek o'ynaydi.
Sabab / Maqsad
because of / due to + ot; in order to + V1 / for + ot
He retired due to illness. / He trains in order to win.
U kasallik sababli sportni tark etdi. / U yutish uchun mashq qiladi.
Takrorlik / Daraja
every week, once in a while; to a great extent, almost entirely
He trains twice a week. / Diet affects his results to a great extent.
U haftada ikki marta mashq qiladi. / Ovqatlanish uning natijalariga katta darajada ta'sir qiladi.
Shart / holat
in case of + ot, under pressure
In case of injury, stop immediately.
Jarohat bo'lsa, darhol to'xtang.
Yon berish
despite / in spite of + ot/V-ing
Despite the difficulty, he won.
Qiyinchilikka qaramay, u yutdi.
presentation: When does Djokovic train?
Early in the morning, almost every day.
Where does he prepare?
On the court and in the gym.
How does he eat?
With great care — his diet is gluten-free and mostly plant-based.
Why does he stretch every morning?
In order to prevent injury.
To what extent does sleep affect health?
To a great extent — much more than most people think.
Did he win despite the injury?
Yes, despite a leg injury, he won the final.
CCQ: Despite the rain, they played the match.
Did it rain? (Yes) Did they play? (Yes) Did the rain stop them? (No)
CCQ: The match was cancelled because of the rain.
Did the match happen? (No) Why not? (The rain) After 'because of' — a noun or a full sentence? (A noun)
CCQ: He stretches in order to prevent injury.
Is 'prevent injury' the reason or the aim? (The aim) What form comes after 'in order to'? (V1 — prevent)
CCQ: In case of fire, use the stairs.
Is there a fire now? (No) When do you use the stairs? (If there is a fire)
notes: because of / due to / thanks to + OT (because + gap); despite / in spite of + OT yoki V-ing (although + gap).

Maqsad (odamning niyati): in order to / so as to / to + V1; for + ot ham maqsad (for better results); for + V-ing — buyumning vazifasi (a machine for cleaning), odam maqsadi emas: 'He trains for win' — xato.
Tartib odatda tarz → joy → vaqt: "He trained hard in Belgrade yesterday."
O'quvchi so'raydi: Nega 'despite of' emas? — Javob: despite o'zidan keyin to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ot keladi (despite the rain); 'of' faqat 'in spite of' da bor.
O'quvchi so'raydi: because of va due to farqi bormi? — Javob: ma'nosi bir xil (+ ot); due to rasmiyroq, Writing'da qulay; thanks to — odatda ijobiy natija uchun.
O'quvchi so'raydi: ibora gap boshida tursa vergul shartmi? — Javob: qisqa iboradan keyin ixtiyoriy (In 2010 he…), uzunroq iboradan keyin qo'yiladi (Despite the heavy rain, …).
mistakes: Despite he was injured, he won.
Despite being injured, he won. / Although he was injured, he won.
Because of it rained, we stayed in.
Because of the rain, we stayed in.
He trains in order to win. / He trains to win.
He trained yesterday in Belgrade hard.
He trained hard in Belgrade yesterday.
Due to he was ill, he stayed at home.
Due to his illness, he stayed at home. / Because he was ill, he stayed at home.
due to + ot; to'liq gap bo'lsa — because.

how: CORE 20 — sog'liq va uzoq umr so'zlari (life expectancy, ageing population, chronic illness…); STRONG — tizim va odatlar (susceptible to, place a strain on, sleep deprivation); SUPER — Task 2 kollokatsiyalari (in the long run, at the expense of, promote a healthy lifestyle).
Misolda so'zning o'zi albatta bo'ladi, gap tabiiy va faktik to'g'ri; bugungi grammatika qolipi — ixtiyoriy, faqat tabiiy tushsa.
core: Life expectancy has risen in many countries, largely due to vaccines and better healthcare.
Ko'p mamlakatlarda o'rtacha umr asosan emlash va yaxshiroq tibbiyot tufayli oshdi.
Japan has an ageing population because of low birth rates and long life expectancy.
Yaponiyada past tug'ilish va uzoq umr tufayli aholi qariyapti.
Chronic illnesses become more common with age.
Surunkali kasalliklar yosh o'tgan sari ko'payadi.
The healthcare system is under pressure in winter.
Qishda sog'liqni saqlash tizimi bosim ostida.
Preventive medicine saves money in the long run.
Profilaktik tibbiyot uzoq muddatda pul tejaydi.
A sedentary lifestyle can lead to obesity and heart problems.
Kam harakat turmush tarzi semizlik va yurak muammolariga olib kelishi mumkin.
In many countries obesity has risen sharply, partly because of fast food.
Ko'p mamlakatlarda semizlik qisman fast-fud tufayli keskin oshdi.
Good sleep improves our well-being to a great extent.
Yaxshi uyqu farovonligimizni katta darajada yaxshilaydi.
Despite the stigma, people now talk about mental health more openly.
Tamg'aga qaramay, odamlar endi ruhiy salomatlik haqida ochiqroq gapirishadi.
Good nutrition is especially important for growing teenagers.
To'g'ri oziqlanish o'sayotgan o'smirlar uchun ayniqsa muhim.
A balanced diet helps you stay healthy in the long run.
Muvozanatli ovqatlanish uzoq muddatda sog'lom qolishga yordam beradi.
Regular physical activity helps to prevent many diseases.
Muntazam jismoniy faollik ko'plab kasalliklarning oldini olishga yordam beradi.
Long periods of stress can weaken the immune system.
Uzoq davom etgan stress immunitet tizimini zaiflashtirishi mumkin.
Early diagnosis saves lives in most cases.
Ko'p hollarda erta tashxis hayotni saqlab qoladi.
Treatment is expensive, especially in old age.
In Uzbekistan, the elderly are usually cared for at home by their families.
O'zbekistonda keksalarga odatda uyda oilasi g'amxo'rlik qiladi.
Doctors recommend a check-up once a year, even if you feel fine.
Shifokorlar o'zingizni yaxshi his qilsangiz ham, yiliga bir marta tibbiy ko'rikdan o'tishni tavsiya qiladi.
Cases of dementia are rising, mainly because of ageing populations.
Asosan aholining qarishi tufayli demensiya holatlari ko'paymoqda.
Heart disease kills more people than any other disease, partly because of poor diet.
Yurak kasalligi, qisman noto'g'ri ovqatlanish tufayli, boshqa har qanday kasallikdan ko'proq odamning hayotiga zomin bo'ladi.
Rest and good food can speed up recovery after an illness.
Dam olish va yaxshi ovqat kasallikdan keyin sog'ayishni tezlashtirishi mumkin.
strong: The elderly are susceptible to infection, especially in winter.
An ageing population places a strain on hospitals and pension systems.
Qariyotgan aholi kasalxonalar va pensiya tizimlariga og'irlik tushiradi.
Low birth rates can lead to a demographic imbalance.
Past tug'ilish demografik nomutanosiblikka olib kelishi mumkin.
In an ageing society, the workforce shrinks as more people retire.
Qariyotgan jamiyatda ko'proq odam nafaqaga chiqqani sari ishchi kuchi kamayadi.
The tax burden on young workers grows because of rising pension costs.
Pensiya xarajatlari oshgani sababli yosh ishchilar zimmasidagi soliq yuki o'sadi.
Long-term care is provided at home in most Uzbek families.
Ko'p o'zbek oilalarida uzoq muddatli parvarish uyda beriladi.
For many older people, quality of life matters more than length of life.
Ko'p keksalar uchun hayot sifati umr uzunligidan muhimroq.
Intergenerational support works well in Uzbekistan.
parvarishlovchi (bemor yoki keksa kishiga qaraydigan odam)
Many carers are family members who look after an elderly parent at home.
Ko'p parvarishlovchilar uyda keksa ota-onasiga qaraydigan oila a'zolaridir.
Active ageing keeps the elderly healthy in spite of their age.
Faol qarish keksalarni yoshiga qaramay sog'lom saqlaydi.

class_ex.title: Ex2 — Ergash gap → ravish iborasi (Writing)

items: Although he was ill, he played.

He trains so that he can win.
Because people live longer, pensions are under pressure.

answers: Despite his illness / Despite being ill / In spite of being ill, he played.
Because of the rain / Due to the rain, the match stopped.

Because of / Due to longer life expectancy, pension systems are under pressure.

class_ex.title: SPEAKING — Weather (og'zaki): Part 1, 2, 3
class_ex.instr: (12 daq, juftlik) 2 daq — Part 1: juftlikda 4 savol, har javob 2–3 gap (javob + sabab + misol). 1 daq — Kartochka A, tayyorgarlik: faqat 5–6 kalit so'z. 2 daq — A gapiradi, B S-CHECK-4.0 ni to'ldiradi. 2 daq — ustoz NAMUNA A ni o'qiydi, o'quvchilar box'dagi iboralarni belgilaydi. 2 daq — B shu kartochka bo'yicha gapiradi (box'dan 2+ ibora bilan). 2 daq — Part 3 juftlikda. 1 daq — ustoz feedback (S-4.0). ICQ: Necha daqiqa tayyorlanasiz? (1) Tayyorgarlikda to'liq gap yozasizmi? (Yo'q, faqat kalit so'z)
items: Part 1: What's the weather like in your city today?
Part 1: Which season do you like most? Why?
Part 1: How often do you check the weather forecast?
Part 1: Does the weather change your mood?
KARTOCHKA A: Describe your favourite season of the year. You should say: which season it is ; what the weather is like ; what you usually do in this season ; and explain why you like it.
Part 3: How does the weather affect people's health?
Part 3: Do people do less sport in winter? Why?
Part 3: Is the weather in Uzbekistan changing? How?
box: in the early morning, when it's still cool
because of the heat / due to the cold
in order to keep warm / in order to stay active
It keeps me physically active and it's good for my mental health.
What I like most about it is that …
answers: Part 1 namuna (1): Today it's sunny but a bit windy, about eighteen degrees. It was quite cold in the early morning, so I wore a jacket, but now it's really pleasant.
Part 1 namuna (2): I like autumn most, mainly because the weather isn't too hot. I can play football outside without feeling tired after ten minutes.
Part 1 namuna (3): I check it almost every morning on my phone in order to choose the right clothes. It's especially useful in March and April, because the weather changes so quickly.
Part 1 namuna (4): Yes, to a great extent. On grey, rainy days I feel lazy, but when it's sunny I'm full of energy and I want to go out.

NAMUNA A (faqat ustoz uchun, Band 5.5–6, ~169 so'z, ~1.5–2 daqiqa): I'd like to talk about autumn, especially September and October, because for me it's the best time of the year in Uzbekistan. After the long summer the weather finally becomes comfortable: it's usually about twenty degrees during the day, and in the early morning it's quite cool, so I need a light jacket. In autumn I spend a lot of time outside, so I get more physical activity. Twice a week I play football with my classmates after lessons, which is almost impossible in July because of the heat. At weekends my family goes to the bazaar in order to buy melons and grapes, and I eat them with great pleasure. Fresh fruit is a healthy part of a balanced diet, and I think it helps my immune system before winter. I like autumn mainly because it keeps me physically active and it's good for my mental health. I feel calmer, I sleep better, and to a great extent this helps me concentrate when the new school year starts.

Part 3 namuna (1): Weather can affect people's health in many ways. Because of extreme heat, the elderly often have heart problems, so doctors advise them to stay indoors in the afternoon and to drink more water. In cold weather, people catch colds more easily, which is why many of them get a flu jab before winter.

Part 3 namuna (2): Yes, I think most people do less sport in winter because of the cold and the short days. They prefer to stay at home, so their lifestyle becomes more sedentary. However, people who go to a gym or a swimming pool usually continue their physical activity.

Part 3 namuna (3): I believe it is. Summers in Uzbekistan are getting hotter and longer, and in some years there is less snow in the mountains. As a result, farmers have problems with water, and cities plant more trees in order to keep the streets cool.

NAMUNA A dagi bugungi grammatika: in the early morning, twice a week, after lessons, because of the heat, in order to buy, with great pleasure, to a great extent; EW5: balanced diet, immune system, physical activity, mental health.
Baholash: S-4.0 (jadval shu darsda, quyida) + S-CHECK-4.0.
class_ex.note: S-CHECK-4.0 (sherik belgilaydi): 1) kartochkaning 4 bandi aytildimi; 2) 1.5 daqiqadan uzoq, uzun pauzasiz; 3) box'dan 2+ ibora; 4) bugungi grammatika (ravish iboralari) 1–2 marta to'g'ri; 5) Part 3 javobi: fikr + sabab + misol. class_ex.title: WRITING NORMATIV — Working longer hours (yozma, 10 daqiqa)
class_ex.instr: (12 daq, yakka) 1 daq — ustoz savolni proyektorda ko'rsatadi va qoidani aytadi. 9 daq — yakka: kirish + 1 body paragraf (110–140 so'z), daftarga; telefon, lug'at va namuna YO'Q. 2 daq — W-CHECK-4.0 bilan o'zini tekshirish, so'z sonini oxirida yozadi; ishlar yig'iladi (W-4.0 bilan keyingi darsgacha baholanadi). Bu normativda W-CHECK 6 va W-4.0 LR — EW4 (Work) so'zlari bo'yicha (savol 4-dars mavzusida). ICQ: Nechta abzats yozasiz? (2: kirish + 1 body) Namunaga yoki 4-dars inshosiga qarash mumkinmi? (Yo'q)
items: Question: Many people are working longer hours. What are the causes of this, and what effects does it have on individuals and society?
Qoida: kirish (savol o'z so'zlaringiz bilan + insho rejasi) + 1 body paragraf (sabablar YOKI oqibatlar), jami 110–140 so'z, 9 daqiqa; daftar, namunasiz, telefonsiz.

Body: Topic sentence -> Explain -> Example -> Link. Bugungi ravish iboralari (because of / due to / in order to / despite) 1–2 marta; EW 4 (Work) so'zlaridan kamida 4 tasi (W-CHECK 6-band va W-4.0 LR shu normativda EW4 bo'yicha tekshiriladi).
W-CHECK-4.0 eslatma: 1) kirishda parafraz; 2) topic sentence; 3) aniq misol; 5) bugungi grammatika; 7) so'z soni oxirida yozilgan.
answers: NAMUNA kirish + body (faqat ustoz uchun, Band 5.5–6, 136 so'z; 4-dars namunasidan FARQLI g'oya — o'zini o'zi band qilganlar va ilova orqali ishlaydigan haydovchilar/kuryerlar: barqaror daromad yo'qligi sababli 11–12 soat ishlash): Nowadays, a growing number of workers spend longer hours at work. This essay will explain why this is happening and how it affects both individuals and society. One important cause is the growth of the gig economy. Many young people are now self-employed taxi or delivery drivers who find orders through mobile apps. Despite the freedom of this job, they have no job security and no fixed salary, because they are paid only for each trip. Due to low prices per order, drivers stay online for eleven or twelve hours in order to earn a living. For example, a courier in Samarkand may work from nine in the morning until nine at night to keep a high rating. In this way, the lack of a steady income can turn a normal job into a twelve-hour day.

Tekshiruv kaliti: kirish — savol parafrazi (are working longer hours -> spend longer hours at work; what effects … on individuals and society -> how it affects both individuals and society) + reja; body — topic sentence (One important cause is the growth of the gig economy), izoh (self-employed, kafolatlangan maosh yo'q, har buyurtma uchun to'lov), aniq misol (Samarqanddagi kuryer, ertalab 9 dan kechki 9 gacha, reyting uchun), link (In this way, … a twelve-hour day); ravish iboralari: Despite the freedom of this job, Due to low prices per order, in order to earn a living, from nine in the morning until nine at night, In this way; EW4: gig economy, self-employed, job security, salary, earn a living, a steady income (6 ta).
Baholash: W-4.0 (jadval shu darsda, quyida) + W-CHECK-4.0; NORM-4.0: 10–12 ball — 2 coin; 7–9 — bajarildi; ≤6 — uyda qayta yozadi.
class_ex.note: Manba: Kitob IELTS 4.0, SAMPLE ESSAYS, Topic 9 — faqat savol olindi (4-dars inshosi savoli); namuna Jony Academy original matni, 4-dars namunasidagi g'oyalar (narx oshishi va ikkinchi ish, smartfon orqali kechki xabarlar, Toshkentdagi o'qituvchilar) takrorlanmaydi. homework.title: 1. Lug'at: Essential Words 5 CORE 20 — Jony Student flashcard
homework.instr: Essential Words 5 CORE 20 — Jony Student flashcard (har kuni 5 daqiqa).
homework.answers: Ilova tekshiradi; yozma normativ 6-darsda.

homework.title: 2. Grammatika: o'zingiz haqingizda 6 gap
homework.instr: O'zingiz haqingizda 6 gap yozing — har gapda boshqa turdagi ravish iborasi (vaqt, joy, tarz, sabab, maqsad, takrorlik, daraja, shart, yon berish dan 6 tasi).
answers: I usually study in the library after lessons.
I try to eat with great care, especially before exams.
Because of my busy timetable, I sometimes skip breakfast.
I go to bed before eleven in order to get enough sleep.
I play football twice a week.
Despite the cold weather, I walk to school every day.
Tekshirish: formula to'g'ri (because of / despite + ot yoki V-ing; in order to + V1), tartib tarz → joy → vaqt, ma'no tabiiy.

homework.title: 3. Tarjima (5 gap)
homework.instr: O'zbekchadan inglizchaga; har gapda ravish iborasi.
items: Stress tufayli u yaxshi uxlay olmaydi.
Charchaganiga qaramay, u mashg'ulotni oxirigacha bajardi.
Sog'lom bo'lish uchun men har kuni ertalab yuguraman.
Yaxshi uyqu kayfiyatimizga katta darajada ta'sir qiladi.
Yong'in chiqqan taqdirda liftdan foydalanmang.
answers: Because of stress, he can't sleep well. / He can't sleep well due to stress.
Despite being tired / Despite his tiredness, he finished the workout.
I run every morning in order to stay healthy. / I go running every morning to stay healthy.
Good sleep affects our mood to a great extent.
In case of fire, do not use the lift.

homework.title: SPEAKING NORMATIV — Weather (og'zaki, ovozli): Kartochka B
homework.instr: 4-topshiriq, MAJBURIY. Kartochka B bo'yicha: 1 daqiqa tayyorgarlik (faqat 5–6 kalit so'z), keyin 1.5–2 daqiqa to'xtamasdan gapirib, ovozli yozuvni ilovaga yuboring. Ravish iboralaridan (because of / in order to / despite / in the early morning …) kamida 2 tasini va EW5 so'zlaridan 2–3 tasini ishlating. 1 marta qayta yozish mumkin; yozilgan matnni o'qib bermang.
items: KARTOCHKA B: Describe a day when the weather changed your plans. You should say: when it was ; what you had planned ; what the weather was like ; and explain what you did instead.
answers: NAMUNA B (faqat ustoz uchun, Band 5.5–6, ~157 so'z): I'd like to describe a Saturday last March when the weather completely changed my plans. My friends and I had planned a trip to the mountains in order to walk and have a picnic, and we wanted to leave in the early morning. However, when I woke up, it was raining heavily and a strong, cold wind was blowing. The forecast said it might snow in the mountains, so because of the bad weather our parents didn't let us go. At first I was really disappointed, but then we made another plan. We went to an indoor sports centre and played table tennis for two hours, so we still got some physical activity. After that we cooked plov together at my friend's house and ate it with great pleasure. Despite the rain, it was a great day. It taught me that a flexible plan is good for my mental health, because I don't get stressed so easily.
Namunadagi bugungi grammatika: in order to walk, in the early morning, because of the bad weather, for two hours, with great pleasure, Despite the rain; EW5: physical activity, mental health.
Baholash: S-4.0 / S-CHECK-4.0 (class_ex dagi jadval), NORM-4.0: 10–12 ball — 2 coin; 7–9 — bajarildi; ≤6 — qayta yozib yuboradi.
homework.note: Namuna o'quvchiga baholangandan keyin ko'rsatiladi. Manba: Kitob IELTS 4.0, SAMPLE SPEAKING, Topic: Weather — faqat mavzu; namuna Jony Academy original.

homework.title: 6. QO'SHIMCHA: STRONG 20 + ovozli normativ
homework.instr: STRONG 20 — flashcard; ovozli normativ: CORE 20 (inglizcha + tarjima), 2 daqiqa, ovozli xabar.
homework.answers: Ustoz tinglaydi: 18–20 so'z 2 daqiqada = 2 coin; STRONG 20 — +2 coin.

normativ: CORE 20, 4 daqiqa yozish + 1 daqiqa tekshirish; 18–20 to'g'ri
Kombinatsiya — because of / due to / despite + ot; in order to + V1
juftlikda 3 daqiqada: 4 to'g'ri gap = warm-up; 6 = normativ; 8 = coin
CORE 20: inglizcha → o'zbekcha + 1 gap, 2 daqiqa; yozma — 6-darsda
10 daq, kirish + 1 body 110–140 so'z, namunasiz, W-4.0

reading.title: Novak Djokovic — winning against all odds, with great care
text: A. Novak Djokovic was born in 1987 in Belgrade, Serbia. As a child he practised on a tennis court in the mountains, and during the NATO bombing of Belgrade in 1999 he sometimes trained in an empty swimming pool. Despite the war, he did not stop practising. In 2008, at the age of 20, he won his first Grand Slam title in Australia.

B. For several years he was the third-best player in the world, behind Federer and Nadal. One reason was his stamina: in long matches he often had breathing problems and sometimes could not finish. In 2010 a doctor suggested, almost by chance, that he might have a gluten intolerance. Djokovic changed his diet with great care — no gluten and very little dairy or sugar — and in 2011 he became world number one for the first time. In total he has spent more than 400 weeks at the top of the rankings, a record, and he has won more Grand Slam singles titles than any other man in history.

C. His daily routine is famous for its discipline. Every morning he wakes at dawn and drinks a glass of warm water. Then he does a long stretching session in order to prevent injuries, and he often meditates so as to stay calm under pressure. Even on a bad day, he follows the same routine. Thanks to this lifestyle, he was still winning big titles in his late thirties: in 2024, at the age of 37, he won Olympic gold in Paris.

D. His career has not been free of controversy. In 2022 he was deported from Australia because of his refusal to be vaccinated against Covid-19, and many people criticised him. A year later he returned and won the tournament again. His story shows that resilience is built slowly, through hard work on ordinary days that nobody sees.
(Jony Academy tomonidan o'quv maqsadida yozilgan matn.)
glossary: Grand Slam — tennisdagi 4 ta eng nufuzli turnir (Katta dubulg'a)

tasks.title: 1. Multiple choice — A, B, C yoki D
tasks.instr: (1 daq — gist, keyin tekshirish) To'g'ri variantni tanlang. 3 savol.
items: 1 Why did Djokovic change his diet in 2010? A) He wanted to lose weight. B) A doctor thought he might have a gluten intolerance. C) Federer advised him to. D) He had a serious injury.
2 According to paragraph C, why does he stretch every morning? A) to relax before breakfast B) to prevent injuries C) to stay calm under pressure D) to wake up at dawn
3 What is paragraph D mainly about? A) his results in Australia over many years B) a difficult period and how he came back C) why vaccines are important D) what his fans think about him
why: B: 'a doctor suggested … a gluten intolerance'.
B: 'stretching session in order to prevent injuries'; C — meditatsiya maqsadi (distraktor).
B: deportatsiya, tanqid, keyin qaytib g'alaba. A, D — tafsilot.

tasks.title: 2. TRUE / FALSE / NOT GIVEN
tasks.instr: (7 daq, yakka) Matnga ko'ra: TRUE, FALSE yoki NOT GIVEN. 6 band.
items: The war in 1999 made him stop practising tennis.
He won his first Grand Slam title before his 21st birthday.
The doctor who noticed his food problem was also a tennis coach.
On difficult days, he does not follow his usual morning routine.
He enjoys playing in Australia more than in any other country.
After leaving Australia in 2022, he later went back and won the same tournament.
why: A: 'Despite the war, he did not stop practising'.
A: 'at the age of 20, he won his first Grand Slam title'.
B: faqat 'a doctor'; murabbiyligi aytilmagan.
C: 'Even on a bad day, he follows the same routine'.
D: qaysi mamlakatni ko'proq yoqtirishi aytilmagan.
D: 'A year later he returned and won the tournament again'.

tasks.title: 3. Sentence completion — NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS
tasks.instr: (3 daq, yakka) Matndan aynan olingan ko'pi bilan 2 so'z yozing. 4 gap.
items: During the bombing, he sometimes trained in an empty ___.
In long matches, he often had ___.
Every morning he drinks a glass of ___.
His story shows that resilience is built through hard work on ___ that nobody sees.

tasks.title: 4. ZAXIRA: Matndan ravish iboralarini toping
tasks.instr: (vaqt qolsa yoki uyga) Matndan har turga bitta ibora yozing. 5 band.
items: takrorlik
tarz
maqsad
sabab
yon berish

because of his refusal to be vaccinated / thanks to this lifestyle

listening.audios: Audio fayl yo'q — ustoz transcript'ni o'qiydi (kitobdagi Audio 21–30 bu darsda ishlatilmaydi).
intro: You will hear a lecturer talking about a study of ageing in a small town.
1-tinglash: eslatmalarni to'ldiring; 2-tinglash: javoblarni tekshiring.
Write ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.

tasks.title: Note completion — ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER (IELTS Part 4)
tasks.instr: Eslatmalarni to'ldiring. 7 band.
items: Length of the study: ___ years
Life expectancy in the town today: ___
Biggest reason for longer lives: better ___
The greatest pressure is on ___
Residents over 65: one in ___
The council offers free ___ for adults over 50
Walking groups meet every ___ morning

transcript: USTOZ UCHUN: 2 marta o'qing; monolog (IELTS Part 4) — ustoz o'zi, ma'ruzachi ovozida, sekin va aniq o'qiydi.

Lecturer: Good morning, everyone. Today I'm going to present the results of our study of ageing in Greenfield, a medium-sized town. We had planned to follow the residents for ten years, but in the end the study lasted twelve years.
Lecturer: First, life expectancy. When we started, it was 74. Today the average person in Greenfield lives to 78.
Lecturer: Why? Many people expected diet to be the main reason, and diet did help to some degree. However, the biggest factor was better healthcare, especially faster diagnosis.
Lecturer: Of course, longer lives also bring problems. Some residents worried about schools, but in fact the greatest pressure is on hospitals, where waiting times have doubled.
Lecturer: At the moment, one in five residents — sorry, let me correct that — one in four residents is over 65.

Lecturer: So what can be done? The town council looked at free gym membership, but it was too expensive. Instead, it now offers free check-ups for all adults over 50, in order to find illnesses early.
Lecturer: The council has also started walking groups. At first they met on Sundays, but because of low numbers they now meet every Saturday morning in the central park.
Lecturer: In the long run, we believe prevention will cost the town far less than treatment. Thank you.

kahoot.q: ___ the heavy rain, we stayed at home.
kahoot.explain: because of + OT (the rain). because dan keyin to'liq gap keladi.

kahoot.q: ___ being injured, he won the match.
kahoot.explain: despite + V-ing/ot. although + to'liq gap; in spite dan keyin OF kerak.

kahoot.q: He trains every day ___ win the championship.
kahoot.explain: Maqsad + fe'l → in order to + V1. "for win" — xato.

kahoot.q: Qaysi gapda so'z tartibi TO'G'RI?
options: He trained hard in Belgrade yesterday.
He trained yesterday in Belgrade hard.
He trained in Belgrade hard yesterday.
He trained yesterday hard in Belgrade.
kahoot.explain: Tartib: tarz (hard) → joy (in Belgrade) → vaqt (yesterday).

kahoot.q: The match was cancelled ___ bad weather.
kahoot.explain: due TO + ot = ... sababli. because dan keyin gap kerak (because the weather was bad).

kahoot.q: ___ fire, use the stairs, not the lift.
kahoot.explain: Ogohlantirishlarda: in case OF + ot = ... bo'lsa (yuz bersa).

kahoot.q: Qaysi gapda XATO bor?
options: Despite he was tired, he finished.
Although he was tired, he finished.
In spite of the pain, he finished.
kahoot.explain: despite dan keyin to'liq gap kelmaydi: despite being tired / although he was tired.

kahoot.q: "because of" dan keyin nima keladi?
kahoot.explain: because of / due to / thanks to + OT; because + to'liq gap.

kahoot.q: She plays tennis ___ a real professional.
kahoot.explain: Tarz: like + ot = ...dek (like a professional).

kahoot.q: A good diet affects your health ___ a great extent.
kahoot.explain: Daraja iborasi: to a great extent = katta darajada.

kahoot.q: I visit my grandparents in the village ___ a while.
kahoot.explain: once in a while = vaqti-vaqti bilan, ba'zan.

kahoot.q: Tarjima: "U kasallik sababli sportni tark etdi."
kahoot.explain: Sabab: due to + ot (due to illness). because dan keyin "of" kerak edi.

kahoot.q: A lifestyle with very little physical activity is ___.
kahoot.explain: sedentary lifestyle = kam harakat turmush tarzi.

kahoot.q: An illness that lasts for a very long time is a ___ illness.
kahoot.explain: chronic illness = surunkali kasallik.

kahoot.q: The condition of being very overweight is called ___.
kahoot.explain: obesity = semizlik.

kahoot.q: In Japan, ___ is very high — people there live very long lives.
kahoot.explain: life expectancy = o'rtacha umr ko'rish davomiyligi.

kahoot.q: Vaccination is an example of ___ medicine.
kahoot.explain: preventive medicine = profilaktik (oldini oluvchi) tibbiyot.

kahoot.q: Old people can be more ___ infections. (moyil)
kahoot.explain: susceptible to = ...ga moyil (kasallikka tez chalinadigan).

kahoot.q: Pensions for the elderly increase the tax ___ on workers.
kahoot.explain: tax burden = soliq yuki.

kahoot.q: "uyqusizlik" — inglizcha?
kahoot.explain: sleep deprivation = uyqusizlik (yetarli uxlamaslik).

lessons.title: Be allowed to, Be permitted to, Be supposed to
lessons.grammar_topic: BE ALLOWED TO (ruxsat) / BE PERMITTED TO (rasmiy ruxsat) / BE SUPPOSED TO (kutilgan, qoida bo'yicha)
lessons.vocab_topic: Essential Words 6 — Law, rules and society (qonun, qoidalar va jamiyat)
lessons.book_ref: Student's book IELTS 4.0: Lesson 6 – Be allowed to, be permitted to, be supposed to (ixtiyoriy; dars kitobsiz o'tadi). Writing: Jony Academy savoli (kitob SAMPLE ESSAYS uslubida); namuna original. Kitob audiolari ishlatilmaydi; listening — Jony Academy skripti. Reading — Nelson Mandela (Jony Academy matni, uyga).

Dars oxirida o'quvchi can / should / let gaplarini kerakli zamonda be allowed / supposed to bilan qayta yozadi (Ex2).
Dars oxirida o'quvchi Essential Words 6 CORE 20 dan kamida 16 tasini o'zbekchadan inglizchaga aytadi.
Dars oxirida o'quvchi discuss-both-views insho rejasini (2 view + fikr, har biriga misol) tuzadi.
