lessons.book_ref: Student's book IELTS 4.0: Lesson 25 – Phrasal verbs PUT (ixtiyoriy; dars kitobsiz o'tadi). Essential Words 25 — Jony Academy ro'yxati (faqat tizimda). Kitob audiolari ishlatilmaydi; listening — Jony Academy skripti. Reading — Oybek (Jony Academy matni, uyga). Speaking: Kitob SAMPLE SPEAKING, Topic: Education — faqat mavzu; namunalar original.
objectives: Dars oxirida o'quvchi 7 ta asosiy PUT phrasal verbni ma'nosiga qarab tanlaydi (Ex1: 8 tadan kamida 6 tasi).
Dars oxirida o'quvchi olmoshni to'g'ri joyga qo'yadi (put it on; put up with it) va put off + V-ing ni ishlatadi (Ex2: 7 tadan kamida 5 tasi).
Dars oxirida o'quvchi 1–18-darslar grammatikasidagi xatoli gaplarni topib tuzatadi (auksion: 12 tadan kamida 8 tasi).

Dars oxirida o'quvchi Final Test A–E ni 45 daqiqada bajaradi; oxirgi guruh Part 2 bo'yicha 1.5–2 daqiqa gapiradi (S-4.0). Qolganlar Education mavzusida Kartochka A (kelajakdagi maqsad) bo'yicha 1.5 daqiqa, box'dagi 2+ ibora va PUT fe'lini 1–2 marta ishlatib gapiradi (S-CHECK-4.0 ning 5 bandidan kamida 4 tasi).
materials: Final Test (tests/final) — o'quvchi varaqlari; skript, kalit va namunalar faqat ustozda.
grammar.formulas va Essential Words 25 CORE 20 — proyektor (lug'at faqat tizimda).
Kahoot: 'O'tgan dars Kahooti' tugmasi (24-dars).

Auksion gaplari (class_ex) — proyektor. Speaking: Part 1 savollari, Kartochka A (25-dars F kartasi), Part 3 va box iboralari (class_ex SPEAKING — Education) — proyektor; Final Speaking ball varag'i (F ustuni); Kartochka B — uyga (QO'SHIMCHA, ovozli).
Reading — uyga; Listening transcript — faqat ustozda (ZAXIRA).
Rubrikalar: W-4.0 / S-4.0 (Final Test E/F bo'limidagi jadval) + S-CHECK — class_ex dagi jadval (proyektor); TEST-4.0.
timeline: Salomlashish
Telefonlar yig'iladi, partalar test uchun alohida qo'yiladi. Kirish savoli: "Which lesson of IELTS 4.0 was the most useful for you?" (2 o'quvchi).
TAKROR: Kahoot — 24-dars (Phrasal verbs — SET)

'O'tgan dars Kahooti' tugmasi → 24-dars savollari (20 ta). Bugungi darsning Kahooti bu yerda EMAS — u 5.0 kursining 1-darsida yoki uyga (ixtiyoriy) o'ynaladi. Oxirgi 1 daqiqa: eng ko'p xato qilingan 2 savol izohi.
TAKROR: Yozma normativ — Essential Words 24 (Citizenship, national identity and government)

Normativ — belgilangan vaqtda bajariladigan qisqa o'lchov; natijasiga qarab coin beriladi. 24-dars CORE 20: ustoz o'zbekchasini aytadi, o'quvchi inglizchasini yozadi — 4 daq; 1 daq sherik bilan almashib tekshirish. 18–20 = 2 coin; 15–17 = bajarildi; 14 va kam = darsdan keyin (15 daqiqa) qayta topshiradi.
KURS TAKRORI — 'Xatoni top' auksioni (1–18-darslar grammatikasi)
3–4 kishilik jamoalar, har birida 1 000 ball. 1 daq — qoida va ICQ; 8 daq — auksion (12 gap, class_ex); 3 daq — '4.0 grammatika — takror' (6 gap og'zaki, +100 ball). G'olib jamoaga 3 coin.
FINAL TEST (final) — 1–24-darslar

Test: tests/final (tizim). D Listening 6 (5 daq, birinchi) · A Grammatika 24 (12 daq) · B Lug'at 12 (5 daq) · C Reading 10 (11 daq) · E Writing 12 (12 daq, W-4.0) = 64; F Speaking 12 — 23–25-darslarning SPEAKING bosqichida. Jami 76. Telefonlar yig'iladi; javoblar test paytida ko'rsatilmaydi; natija — 2 ish kuni ichida individual feedback varag'i orqali.
YANGI GRAMMATIKA — Phrasal verbs PUT (7 asosiy) + CCQ

Lead-in (2 daq): ustoz harakat bilan ko'rsatadi — "I put on my jacket… I put my phone away…" → formula proyektorda, 7 asosiy fe'l + misol (5 daq) → CCQ (4 daq; grammar.presentation) → olmosh o'rni va put off + V-ing (2 daq) → 1 daq tez og'zaki tekshiruv. ZAXIRA fe'llar faqat proyektorda.
LUG'AT — Essential Words 25 CORE 20 (tanishtiruv)

20 so'z proyektorda talaffuz + tarjima (2 daq); aspiration, persistence, milestone, procrastination — CCQ yoki misol (2 daq); juftlikda A o'zbekchasini, B inglizchasini aytadi (1 daq). Yozma normativ yo'q (kurs yakuni).
SINF MASHQLARI — PUT (Ex1–Ex2) + ZAXIRA
Ex1 4 daq yakka · Ex2 5 daq juftlik · 1 daq kalit. ZAXIRA — vaqt qolsa: Ta'lim lug'ati.
SPEAKING — Education (Final Speaking oxirgi guruhi)

class_ex 'SPEAKING — Education (og'zaki)', juftlikda: 1' Part 1 (3 savol) · 1' tayyorgarlik (5–6 kalit so'z) · 2' A Kartochka A, B S-CHECK-4.0 ni to'ldiradi · 2' ustoz NAMUNA A ni o'qiydi, o'quvchilar box'dagi iboralarni belgilaydi · 2' B shu kartochkada (box'dan 2+ ibora bilan) · 1' Part 3 (umumiy, 3-shaxsda) · 1' ustoz feedback (S-4.0). Final Speaking — oxirgi guruh: Kartochka A = 25-dars F kartasi; ustoz 23–24-darslarda baholanmagan 4–5 o'quvchini (A rolida, NAMUNA A dan OLDIN) Part 2 bo'yicha S-4.0 da baholab ball varag'ining F ustuniga yozadi; qolganlar juftlikda shu kartani mashq qiladi. Ulgurilmasa — 'Kurs yakuni' bosqichidagi 4 daqiqalik ZAXIRA o'yini o'rniga. Kartochka B — uyga (QO'SHIMCHA, ovozli).
Kurs yakuni + uyga vazifa

2 daq — 5.0 ga o'tish qoidasi (TEST-4.0): O'TDI — jami ≥ 70% va har bo'limda ≥ 50%; SHARTLI — 60–69% yoki biror bo'lim < 50% (1 hafta ichida qayta); O'TMADI — < 60% (4 intensiv mashg'ulot + qayta Final). Natija 2 ish kuni ichida o'quvchi va ota-onaga. 2 daq — uyga vazifa. 4 daq — ZAXIRA: 7 phrasal verb guruhi o'yini. Vaqt yetmasa: ZAXIRA mashqlar va reading'ning 'find' topshirig'i uyga o'tadi.

intro: put on — kiymoq (↔ take off); tadbir o'tkazmoq ("The school put on a concert"); vazn olmoq ("put on weight").
put off — keyinga surmoq (+ V-ing: "Stop putting off studying"); ko'nglini sovutmoq ("The smell put me off my food").
put out — o'chirmoq (olov, sham). put up with — chidamoq ("I can't put up with this noise") — 3 so'zli, ajralmaydi.
put away — joyiga yig'ishtirib qo'ymoq. put down — pastga qo'ymoq; yozib qo'ymoq ("Put your name down"); kamsitmoq. put together — yig'moq, tuzmoq (jamoa, reja).
ZAXIRA (faqat tanishtiriladi, mashq/Kahoot'ga kirmaydi): put in (mehnat sarflamoq), put aside (tejab qo'ymoq), put across (tushuntirmoq), put through (telefonda ulamoq).
formulas: put on / put off
put on + kiyim/spektakl/vazn; put off + ish/uchrashuv / V-ing
He put on his jacket. / The theatre put on a great show. / They put off the meeting until Monday. / The smell put me off my food.
U kurtkasini kiydi. / Teatr ajoyib spektakl qo'ydi. / Uchrashuvni dushanbagacha kechiktirishdi. / Hid ishtahamni yo'qotdi.
put out / put up with
put out + olov; put up with + narsa/odam (ajralmaydi)
They put out the fire quickly. / I can't put up with this noise anymore.
Ular olovni tez o'chirishdi. / Bu shovqinga endi toqat qilolmayman.
put away / put down
put + narsa + away (joyiga); put down + narsa / ism; put + KIM + down (kamsitmoq)
Put your phone away during the test. / Put your name down on the list. / Don't put other people down.
Test paytida telefoningni olib qo'y. / Ismingni ro'yxatga yozib qo'y. / Boshqalarni kamsitma.
put together
put together + jamoa / reja / narsa (yig'moq, tuzmoq); olmosh bilan: put it together
She put together a team of five. / Let's put together a revision plan.
U besh kishilik jamoa tuzdi. / Keling, takrorlash rejasini tuzamiz.
ZAXIRA: put in / put aside
put in + mehnat/vaqt; put aside + pul/vaqt
He put in a lot of effort. / He put some money aside for his studies.
U ko'p mehnat qildi. / U o'qishi uchun pul tejab qo'ydi.
ZAXIRA: put across / put through
put + fikr + across; put + KIM + through to + KIM
He put his ideas across clearly. / Can you put me through to the manager?
U fikrlarini aniq tushuntirdi. / Meni rahbarga ulab bera olasizmi?
presentation: It's cold. What do you do with your coat?
I put it on. (put on ↔ take off)
The exam is tomorrow, but you want to watch a film. What mustn't you do?
I mustn't put off revising. (put off + V-ing)
Did Oybek put off writing when he became ill?
No. He couldn't speak clearly, so he put his ideas down on paper.
CCQ: They put off the meeting.
Did the meeting happen today? (No) Will it happen later? (Yes)
CCQ: The firefighters put out the fire.
Is the fire still burning? (No) Did they start it? (No)
CCQ: I can't put up with this noise.
Do I like the noise? (No) Is it easy for me to accept it? (No)
CCQ: She put her books away.
Are the books on the desk now? (No) Are they in their place? (Yes)
CCQ: He always puts his classmates down.
Does he say nice things about them? (No) Do they feel good? (No)
notes: put on ↔ take off (kiyim); put off ≠ put out (kechiktirmoq ≠ o'chirmoq).
put off + V-ing: "put off going" (put off to go — xato).
O'quvchi so'raydi: Nega "put it on" deymiz-u, "put up with it" da olmosh oxirida? — Javob: put up with — 3 so'zli fe'l, u ajralmaydi; olmosh with dan keyin keladi: I can't put up with it.
O'quvchi so'raydi: "put off the fire" nega xato? — Javob: put off — keyinga surmoq; olovni o'chirish — put out (the fire).
Final testga 1–24-darslar kiradi; PUT testga kirmaydi.
mistakes: I can't put up this noise.

They put off meeting until Monday.
The firefighters put off the fire.
The firefighters put out the fire.
I can't put it up with.
I can't put up with it.
put up with ajralmaydi — olmosh oxirida.

class_ex.title: Final Test — IELTS 4.0 (1–24-darslar): ustoz uchun o'tkazish tartibi va ball jadvali
class_ex.instr: Test 25-darsda, 45 daqiqa (A–E). Speaking (F) test vaqtidan tashqari — 23, 24 va 25-darslarning SPEAKING bosqichida. Jami 76 ball: A 24 + B 12 + C 10 + D 6 + E 12 + F 12.
items: 1. Tayyorgarlik (23-darsgacha): o'quvchi varag'ini (A, B, C matn va savollari, D uchun note jadvali, E uchun 15 qatorli bo'sh joy) o'quvchilar soniga +2 nusxa chop eting. Listening skripti, kalitlar, namuna javoblar va rubrikalar faqat ustozda — chop etiladigan o'quvchi varag'iga kirmaydi.

2. Speaking (F) — 23, 24, 25-darslarda: har darsning SPEAKING bosqichida 4–5 o'quvchi Part 2 kartasi bo'yicha gapiradi (har o'quvchi kursda 1 marta). 23-darsdan oldin ro'yxat tuzing: kim qaysi darsda. Ball S-4.0 rubrikasi bo'yicha darhol ball varag'iga yoziladi. Dars qoldirgan o'quvchi keyingi darsda yoki test kuni test tugagach baholanadi.

3. Test kuni boshlanishidan oldin (2–3 daqiqa, 45 daqiqaga kirmaydi): telefonlar yig'iladi, partalar alohida. Ovoz chiqarib ayting: 5 yozma bo'lim, 64 ball + Speaking 12 ball; o'tish qoidasi — jami ≥ 70% va har bo'limda ≥ 50%.
4. Proyektorda faqat: joriy bo'lim nomi, uning ko'rsatmasi va taymer. Kalit, Listening skripti va namuna javoblar proyektorga CHIQMAYDI.

5. Vaqt tartibi (jami 45 daqiqa): D. Listening — 5 daq. (birinchi bo'lib: skriptni 2 marta o'qiysiz, orasida 20 soniya pauza) → A. Grammatika — 12 daq. → B. Lug'at — 5 daq. → C. Reading — 11 daq. → E. Writing — 12 daq. Listening boshida o'tkaziladi, chunki butun sinf bir vaqtda tinglashi kerak. Har bo'lim oxirida 1 daqiqa qolganini ayting.

6. Listeningni qanday o'qish: 2 rolni ovoz yoki joy o'zgartirib o'qing (yoki ikkinchi rolni boshqa ustoz o'qiydi), tabiiy tezlikda, raqam va harflarni aniq ayting. 1-o'qishdan oldin o'quvchilarga 30 soniya savollarni o'qish uchun bering. Hech bir so'zni takrorlamang va javobni ta'kidlamang.
7. Test vaqtida ustoz savol mazmunini tushuntirmaydi — faqat ko'rsatmani o'zbekcha qaytarishi mumkin. Ko'chirish aniqlansa — o'sha bo'lim 0 ball, sababi ball varag'iga yoziladi.

8. Tekshirish A–D (kalit bo'yicha, har savol 1 ball): A 1–16 — faqat to'g'ri harf; A 17–24 — xato so'z topilgan VA to'g'ri tuzatilgan bo'lsa 1 ball, faqat topilgan bo'lsa 0. B — to'g'ri so'z yoki harf; so'z to'g'ri, bitta harf xatosi bo'lsa ham 1 ball, ikkitadan ko'p — 0. C va D — so'z chegarasidan (NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS / ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER) oshsa — 0; imlo xatosi bo'lsa — 0 (IELTS qoidasi). TRUE/FALSE/NOT GIVEN o'rniga YES/NO yozilsa — 0.

9. Tekshirish E: W-4.0 rubrikasi — 4 mezon × 0–3 = 12 ball. Avval so'zlarni sanang: 120 dan kam (100–119) — TR ko'pi bilan 2; 100 dan kam — TR ko'pi bilan 1. Faqat kirish yoki faqat body yozilgan bo'lsa — TR ko'pi bilan 1. Shubhali ishni ikkinchi ustoz ham baholaydi, o'rtachasi olinadi (butun songa yaxlitlanadi).

10. Natija: ball varag'i test kunining o'zida to'ldiriladi. Natija 2 ish kuni ichida o'quvchiga va ota-onaga bo'limlar bo'yicha (A, B, C, D, E, F va jami) yuboriladi. Kursda keyingi dars yo'q, shuning uchun tahlil individual feedback varag'i orqali beriladi (pastdagi shablon): har o'quvchiga 2 kuchli tomon, 2 ta eng muhim xato va keyingi qadam yoziladi.

11. 25-darsdagi Listening mashqida "Pass mark to go to IELTS 5.0: ___ %" qatori bor — javob: 70 % (76 balldan kamida 54 ball) va har bo'limda kamida 50%. O'quvchilarga aynan shu qoida bilan tushuntiring. "results on ___" — mashqdagi e'londa Monday; haqiqiy natija test kunidan keyin 2 ish kuni ichida beriladi. Diqqat: o'sha skriptdagi vaqtlar (2 soat 40 daqiqa, Speaking in pairs) — mashq uchun to'qima e'lon; haqiqiy Final — 45 daqiqa (A–E), Speaking esa 23–25-darslarda alohida.
answers: Ball → natija → keyingi qadam (jami 76 ball; bo'lim chegarasi 50%: A ≥ 12, B ≥ 6, C ≥ 5, D ≥ 3, E ≥ 6, F ≥ 6):
O'TDI: jami ≥ 54 ball (≥ 70%) VA har bir bo'limda ≥ 50% → IELTS 5.0 ga o'tadi. Coin: 69–76 ball (≥ 90%) — 5 coin; 61–68 ball (80–89%) — 3 coin; 54–60 ball — coin yo'q.

SHARTLI: jami 46–53 ball (60–69%) YOKI jami ≥ 54, lekin bo'lim(lar) < 50% → 1 hafta ichida xato bo'lim(lar) (< 50% bo'lgan bo'lim(lar); jami 60–69% bo'lsa — eng past 1–2 bo'lim) bo'yicha 15 daqiqalik qayta topshirish (dars vaqtidan tashqari, pastdagi "Qayta topshirish banki"dan). Qayta topshirishdan keyin jami ≥ 70% va har bo'lim ≥ 50% bo'lsa → O'TDI → IELTS 5.0. Qayta topshirilgan bo'lim uchun coin berilmaydi.

O'TMADI: jami ≤ 45 ball (< 60%) → ota-onaga xabar (ustoz qo'ng'iroq qiladi yoki uchrashuv); 4.0 ning zaif bo'limlari bo'yicha 4 ta intensiv mashg'ulot (har biri 45–60 daqiqa: grammatika — 1–24-darslar formulalari, lug'at — Essential Words CORE, reading — headings va T/F/NG strategiyasi, listening — note completion, writing — kirish + body paragraf tuzilishi), keyin Final test qayta topshiriladi (Qayta topshirish banki + E va F uchun zaxira savol).
Ikkinchi urinishda ham O'TMADI bo'lsa — ustoz va o'quv bo'limi rahbari ota-ona bilan birga qaror qiladi: IELTS 4.0 ni takrorlash yoki shaxsiy reja.

Hisob misollari: (1) A 20, B 10, C 8, D 5, E 9, F 9 = 61 → 80% → O'TDI, 3 coin. (2) A 18, B 9, C 4, D 5, E 8, F 9 = 53 → 69.7% va C < 5 → SHARTLI: faqat C qayta topshiriladi. (3) A 22, B 11, C 9, D 5, E 5, F 10 = 62 → jami yaxshi, lekin E < 6 → SHARTLI: faqat Writing qayta yoziladi. (4) A 10, B 5, C 4, D 2, E 5, F 6 = 32 → O'TMADI: ota-onaga xabar, 4 intensiv mashg'ulot, qayta Final.

class_ex.title: A. Grammatika (1–16: to'g'ri variant) — 16 ball
class_ex.instr: Choose the correct answer A, B, C or D. (To'g'ri javobni tanlang va harfini aylana ichiga oling.) Time for Section A (1–24): 12 minutes.
items: 1. It is ___ to drive a car without a licence. A) unlegal B) illegal C) inlegal D) dislegal
2. Air ___ in big cities is getting worse every year. A) pollute B) polluted C) pollution D) polluting
3. Since I moved to the city, I haven't ___ sleep well because of the noise. A) could B) can C) been able to D) be able
4. Look at those dark clouds! It ___ rain. A) is going to B) is due to C) rains D) is to
5. The football match was cancelled ___ the heavy rain. A) because B) due to C) in order to D) although
6. Students ___ use their phones during lessons — it's a school rule. A) don't allowed to B) aren't allow to C) aren't allowed to D) not allowed
7. ___ Amu Darya is one of the longest rivers in Central Asia. A) A B) The C) An D) (no article)
8. It's getting dark and the road is dangerous. You ___ go home now. A) had better B) had better to C) would rather to D) prefer
9. When I looked out of the window, two boys were in the middle of a game. I saw them ___ football. A) to play B) played C) plays D) playing
10. I don't like this blue shirt. Can I see the red ___? A) one B) ones C) it D) the one
11. The more you practise, ___ you become. A) more confident B) the most confident C) the more confident D) confident
12. Take a jacket ___ it gets cold in the evening. A) as long as B) in case C) provided D) even
13. My little sister really ___ our grandfather — she wants to become a doctor like him. A) looks after B) looks into C) looks down on D) looks up to
14. It took Kamila two weeks to ___ the flu. A) get over B) get by C) get off D) get across
15. Our plane ___ at 6 a.m. and landed in Istanbul four hours later. A) took up B) took after C) took off D) took over
16. He studied on Saturdays to ___ the lessons he had missed. A) make out B) make into C) make off with D) make up for
why: 1-dars (Prefixes): l bilan boshlangan sifat → il- (illegal).
2-dars (Suffixes): artikl/sifatdan keyin ot kerak → -tion (pollution).
3-dars (be able to): can ning Present Perfect shakli yo'q → have/has (not) been able to + V1.
4-dars (Future): hozirgi dalil (bulutlar) asosida bashorat → be going to.
5-dars (Adverbial phrases): due to + ot (the heavy rain); because dan keyin gap keladi.
6-dars: ruxsat yo'q (qoida) → be + not + allowed to + V1.
7-dars (Definite article): daryo nomlari oldidan the.
8-dars: kuchli maslahat → had better + V1 (to siz).
9-dars: jarayonning o'rtasi ko'rildi → see + O + V-ing.
10-dars: takrorlanmaslik uchun sifat + one (the red one).
12-dars: The more …, the + qiyosiy daraja …
13-dars: ehtiyot chorasi (bo'lib qolsa deb) → in case + Present Simple.
19-dars (LOOK): look up to = hurmat qilmoq, o'rnak olmoq.
20-dars (GET): get over + kasallik = tuzalmoq.
21-dars (TAKE): samolyot + take off = havoga ko'tarilmoq.
22-dars (MAKE): make up for + yo'qotish = o'rnini to'ldirmoq.

so I do → so do I
where did I live → where I lived
don't eat → not to eat (told me not to eat)
turn it up → turn it down
why: 11-dars (Emphasis): It-cleft da shaxs uchun who/that; which — narsa uchun.
14-dars (Referencing — substitution): So + yordamchi + ega (so do I).
15-dars (Linking verbs): taste/look/sound dan keyin sifat, ravish emas.
16-dars (Reported speech): Present Perfect → Past Perfect; the day before orqa siljishni talab qiladi.
17-dars (Reported questions): bilvosita savolda to'g'ri gap tartibi, did yo'q.
18-dars (Reported imperatives): told + O + not to + V1.
23-dars (TURN): uxlash uchun ovozni pasaytirish → turn down.
24-dars (SET): biznes/tashkilot ochmoq → set up.

class_ex.title: C. Reading: "From Rubbish to Business" — 10 ball
class_ex.type: Reading — Matching headings (3) + TRUE / FALSE / NOT GIVEN (4) + Sentence completion (3); 10 × 1 ball
class_ex.instr: Read the text and answer Questions 1–10. (Matnni o'qing va 1–10 savollarga javob bering. TRUE — matnda shunday yozilgan; FALSE — matnga zid; NOT GIVEN — matnda bu haqda ma'lumot yo'q. 8–10: matndan ko'pi bilan IKKI so'z.) Time: 11 minutes.
box: A  Five years ago, the small town of Chust had a serious problem with plastic waste. Bags and bottles blew along the streets, blocked drains and ended up in the river. Tourists who came to see the town's famous old craft workshops often left with a bad impression. The town council collected household rubbish twice a week, but there was no recycling system, so everything was taken to one large landfill outside the town. Many residents complained, yet few people believed that anything could change.

B  Dilnoza Karimova, then a 22-year-old engineering graduate, decided to prove them wrong. After reading about how recycling works in other countries, she set up a small workshop in her uncle's empty garage. With a loan of 15 million soum from a local bank, she bought a second-hand machine that cuts plastic bottles into small pieces. At first, only her two younger brothers helped her, and for eight months the workshop made no profit at all. "Some neighbours thought I was wasting my time," she remembers. "But I was sure the idea would take off."

C  The turning point came when a furniture company in Namangan agreed to buy her plastic pieces and turn them into garden chairs and tables. Suddenly, the workshop had a regular customer. Dilnoza took on six new workers and started a simple collection system: families bring clean bottles to twelve collection points around the town and receive a small payment for every kilo. Schools joined too, and pupils now compete to collect the most plastic each month.

D  Today, the workshop recycles about four tonnes of plastic a month, and the streets of Chust are noticeably cleaner. Two other towns in the region have already asked Dilnoza to help them start similar projects. However, Dilnoza admits that there are still difficulties. Electricity is expensive, and in winter fewer people bring bottles. She is now looking into solar panels to cut her costs. Her advice to young entrepreneurs is simple: "Start small and don't expect quick results. What matters most is that you keep going when others give up."

class_ex.type: D. Listening — ustoz o'qiydigan original skript (2 rol, 2 marta)
class_ex.instr: Faqat ustoz uchun. Proyektorga chiqarilmaydi, o'quvchi varag'iga kirmaydi. Tabiiy tezlikda o'qing; raqamlar va harflab aytilgan ismni aniq ayting, lekin ta'kidlamang.
items: Roles: RECEPTIONIST (Green Future Volunteer Centre) and BEKZOD (student). Read twice. (Ikki rol, 2 marta o'qiladi; o'qishlar orasida 20 soniya pauza.)
RECEPTIONIST: Good morning, Green Future Volunteer Centre. How can I help you?
BEKZOD: Hello. I'd like to register for the tree-planting day. Is it this Sunday?
RECEPTIONIST: No, this year it's on Saturday, because the park is closed on Sunday. Can I have your name, please?
BEKZOD: Bekzod Alimov.
RECEPTIONIST: Thank you, Bekzod. Now, the bus leaves at eight fifteen, but please arrive at seven forty-five, so we have time to give out the tools.
BEKZOD: OK, seven forty-five. And where do we meet? At the bus station?
RECEPTIONIST: A lot of people think so, but no. We meet outside the railway station, next to the main entrance.
BEKZOD: Right. How many trees are you going to plant?
RECEPTIONIST: Last year we planted two hundred and fifty, but this year we have more volunteers, so the plan is three hundred.
BEKZOD: Great. What should I bring? A spade?
RECEPTIONIST: No, we give everyone a spade. Just bring gloves and a raincoat — the forecast says it might rain in the afternoon.
BEKZOD: And how much does it cost?
RECEPTIONIST: The normal price is twenty-five thousand soum, but students pay twenty thousand. That includes lunch and the bus.
BEKZOD: Perfect. Who can I contact if I have any questions?
RECEPTIONIST: The organiser is Ms Nurova. That's N-U-R-O-V-A.
BEKZOD: Thanks a lot. See you on Saturday!
class_ex.note: Distraktorlar: Sunday → Saturday; 8.15 (avtobus) → 7.45 (kelish vaqti); bus station → railway station; 250 (o'tgan yil) → 300; spade (berishadi) → raincoat; 25,000 (to'liq narx) → 20,000 (talaba narxi).

class_ex.title: E. Writing (IELTS Task 2: kirish + bitta body paragraf) — 12 ball
class_ex.type: Writing — Introduction + ONE body paragraph, 120–150 words (W-4.0 rubrikasi, 4 mezon × 3 ball)
class_ex.instr: Read the question. Write an INTRODUCTION and ONE BODY PARAGRAPH (120–150 words). (Savolni o'qing. Kirish va BITTA asosiy abzats yozing, 120–150 so'z.) Time: 12 minutes.
box: Task 2 question: Nowadays many teenagers spend several hours a day on social media. Some people think this does more harm than good. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items: 1. Introduction (2 sentences): paraphrase the question + give your opinion clearly. (Kirish: savolni o'z so'zlaringiz bilan qayta yozing va pozitsiyangizni aniq ayting.)
2. Body paragraph: topic sentence → explanation → example → final sentence. (Asosiy abzats: asosiy gap → izoh → misol → yakuniy gap.)
3. Use linking words: however, for example, as a result, therefore, because … (Bog'lovchilarni ishlating.)
4. Try to use 1–2 structures from the course: The more …, the more/less … ; What … is … ; a phrasal verb (take up, get over, set up …). (Kursdagi 1–2 strukturani ishlating.)
5. Count your words and write the number at the end. (So'zlarni sanab, oxirida sonini yozing.)
answers:
Namuna javob (Band 5.5–6, 131 so'z): These days, a lot of young people spend three or four hours a day on social media apps. In my opinion, this habit usually does more harm than good, mainly because it affects teenagers' mental health and their studies.
The main problem is that social media takes up the time that young people need for sleep and homework. The more time teenagers spend scrolling, the less energy they have for their lessons. For example, my cousin used to check Instagram until midnight, and as a result, she felt tired at school and her marks became lower. What worries me most is that many teenagers also compare themselves with celebrities online, and this can reduce their self-esteem. Therefore, I believe parents and schools should help young people to control their screen time.

Namunada tuzilma: kirish (paraphrase + pozitsiya) → topic sentence (The main problem is …) → izoh (The more …, the less …) → misol (For example, my cousin …) → qo'shimcha g'oya (What worries me most …) → yakuniy gap (Therefore …).
Bog'lovchilar: mainly because, for example, as a result, and, therefore; ishora so'zlar: this habit, this.

Kurs strukturalari namunada: takes up (21-dars), The more …, the less … (12-dars), What worries me most is … (11-dars), felt tired / became lower (15-dars, linking verbs); lug'at: mental health, self-esteem, screen time, social media, celebrities (EW 3, 5, 8, 15).

Baholash: W-4.0 rubrikasi (keyingi jadval), TR + CC + LR + GRA, har biri 0–3 = 12 ball. So'z soni 100–119 → TR ko'pi bilan 2; 100 dan kam yoki faqat kirish/faqat body → TR ko'pi bilan 1; savol mavzusidan tashqari → TR 0. Namuna yodlab yozilgani aniqlansa → 0 ball, SHARTLI yo'li bilan qayta yoziladi.

class_ex.title: F. Speaking (IELTS Part 2) — 12 ball, test vaqtidan tashqari (23, 24, 25-darslar)
class_ex.type: Speaking — Part 2 long turn (S-4.0 rubrikasi, 4 mezon × 3 ball)
class_ex.instr: You will have 1 minute to prepare. Then speak for 1–2 minutes. You can make notes. (1 daqiqa tayyorlanasiz, keyin 1–2 daqiqa gapirasiz. Qisqa yozuv qilishingiz mumkin.)
items: 1. Tartib: 23, 24, 25-darslarning SPEAKING bosqichida har darsda 4–5 o'quvchi (har o'quvchi kursda 1 marta). Qolgan o'quvchilar shu vaqtda juftlikda o'sha kartani mashq qiladi.
2. Har o'quvchi: 1 daqiqa tayyorgarlik (qog'oz va ruchka beriladi) → 1–2 daqiqa monolog (ustoz 2 daqiqada to'xtatadi) → 1 ta yakuniy savol (rounding-off). Jami bir o'quvchiga ≈ 4 daqiqa.
3. 23-dars kartasi — Describe a place in nature that you like to visit. You should say: where it is; how often you go there; what you do there; and explain why this place is special to you.

4. 24-dars kartasi — Describe a tradition in your country that you are proud of. You should say: what the tradition is; when people follow it; who takes part in it; and explain why you are proud of it.

5. 25-dars kartasi — Describe a goal you want to achieve in the future. You should say: what the goal is; when you set it; what you are doing to achieve it; and explain why this goal is important to you.

6. Yakuniy savollar (bittasini tanlang): 23 — Do you think young people spend enough time in nature? 24 — Are traditions less important for young people today? 25 — Is it better to have one big goal or many small goals?
7. Ustoz o'quvchi gapirayotganda gapini bo'lmaydi, tuzatmaydi; faqat vaqtni kuzatadi va rubrika bo'yicha qisqa belgi qo'yadi (masalan: FC 2 — uzun pauzalar).
answers: Namuna javob (23-dars kartasi, Band 5.5–6, 158 so'z, ≈ 1.5–2 daqiqa): I'd like to talk about the Chimgan mountains, which are about two hours from Tashkent by car. I usually go there with my family in spring or in early autumn, when the weather is not too hot. We normally set off early in the morning, so we can avoid the traffic. When we get there, we walk along a small river, have a picnic and sometimes climb to a place with a beautiful view of the valley. The air feels fresh and clean, and it's very quiet, so I can forget about my studies and stress for a while. What I like most is that I can spend time with my parents without phones, because there is almost no connection. Last year I even saw an eagle flying above us, which was amazing. So, I think this place is special for me because it helps me relax, and it reminds me how important it is to protect nature.

Namunada: kartadagi 4 savolning hammasiga javob; bog'lovchilar (so, when, because, and, what I like most); kurs strukturalari — set off (24-dars), feels fresh (15-dars, linking verbs), What I like most is … (11-dars), saw an eagle flying (9-dars); lug'at — valley, protect nature (EW 7, 23).

Baholash: S-4.0 rubrikasi (keyingi jadval), FC + LR + GRA + P, har biri 0–3 = 12 ball. 1 daqiqadan kam gapirsa — FC ko'pi bilan 1. Oldindan yodlangan matnni o'qib bergandek gapirsa — ustoz 2-yakuniy savol beradi va baho shu javob bilan birga qo'yiladi.
Bahoni shu darsning o'zida ball varag'iga yozing (F ustuni). Namuna javob o'quvchilarga baholash tugaguncha ko'rsatilmaydi.

items: A (12 × 2 ball; choose A, B, C or D): 1. She ___ what I said and got angry. A) misunderstood B) disunderstood C) ununderstood D) overunderstood  2. The train ___ at 9.15 tomorrow, so don't be late. A) is leaving to B) will leaving C) leaves D) is about leave  3. Visitors ___ take photos inside the museum. A) What B) That C) Which D) It  6. The earlier you start, ___ you will finish. A) sooner B) the soonest C) the sooner D) the more soon  7. You can borrow my laptop ___ you bring it back tomorrow. A) even B) as long as C) in case of D) due to  8. "I'm working," he said. → He said he ___ working. A) is being B) has C) were D) was  9. She asked me ___ I liked jazz. A) if B) that C) do D) what  10. The coach told us ___ late. A) don't be B) to not being C) not to be D) not be  11. I ___ my mother — we have the same eyes and the same laugh. A) take up B) take after C) take over D) take on  12. We ___ early in the morning to avoid the traffic. A) set up B) set in C) set back D) set off

B (6 × 2 ball; box: renewable, obey, poverty, language, feedback, revenue, orbit, heritage — 2 ortiqcha): 1. Solar and wind power are ___ sources of energy. 2. Every citizen should ___ the law. 3. Millions of people still live below the ___ line. 4. At first, the ___ barrier made it hard for me to make friends abroad. 5. Good leaders give their team useful ___ after every project. 6. The company's ___ grew by 20% last year thanks to online sales.

C (10 × 1 ball; o'sha "From Rubbish to Business" matni, yangi savollar). TRUE / FALSE / NOT GIVEN: 1. Most people in Chust believed the plastic problem would soon be solved. 2. Dilnoza's machine was new when she bought it. 3. Dilnoza's brothers were paid for their work. 4. Schools take part in collecting plastic. 5. The furniture company is the workshop's only customer today. NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS: 6. Before the workshop, the town's rubbish went to a large ______ outside Chust. 7. Dilnoza borrowed ______ soum from the bank. 8. After finding a regular customer, Dilnoza employed ______ new workers. 9. There are ______ collection points around the town. 10. The workshop recycles about ______ of plastic a month.

D (6 × 1 ball): o'sha skript, lekin ustoz o'qishdan oldin 6 ta tafsilotni almashtiradi: 7.45 → 7.30 (8.15 distraktor qoladi); railway station → river station (bus station distraktor qoladi); 300 → 400 (250 qoladi); raincoat → hat ("it will be very sunny"); 20,000 → 15,000 (25,000 qoladi); Nurova → Rahimova (R-A-H-I-M-O-V-A). Note jadvali o'zgarmaydi.
E (12 ball, 12 daqiqa, 120–150 so'z, kirish + bitta body): Some people believe that every student should do unpaid volunteer work in their community. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
F (12 ball): Part 2 kartasi — Describe a person you look up to. You should say: who this person is; how you know them; what they have achieved; and explain why you look up to this person.
answers: B: 1 renewable (EW 2), 2 obey (EW 6), 3 poverty (EW 12), 4 language (EW 14), 5 feedback (EW 18), 6 revenue (EW 22).
C: 1 FALSE (few people believed anything could change), 2 FALSE (second-hand), 3 NOT GIVEN, 4 TRUE, 5 NOT GIVEN, 6 landfill, 7 15 million, 8 six (6), 9 twelve (12), 10 four tonnes.
E: W-4.0 rubrikasi bilan; asosiy testdagi so'z soni qoidalari amal qiladi.
F: S-4.0 rubrikasi bilan; 1 daqiqa tayyorgarlik, 1–2 daqiqa monolog, 1 yakuniy savol (Is it important for teenagers to have role models?).

Ulgurilmasa — 'Kurs yakuni' bosqichidagi ZAXIRA o'yini o'rniga. ICQ: Tayyorgarlikka necha daqiqa? (1) Kartochkada nechta band bor? (4 — 3 ta 'You should say' + 'explain')
items: Part 1: What subject do you enjoy most? Why?
Part 1: Do you prefer studying alone or in a group?
Part 1: What was your primary school like?
KARTOCHKA A: Describe a goal you want to achieve in the future. You should say: what the goal is; when you set it; what you are doing to achieve it; and explain why this goal is important to you.
Part 3: Is face-to-face learning better than online learning?
Part 3: Do exams show what students really know?
Part 3: What life skills should schools teach?
box: One goal I really want to achieve is …
Since then, … has been my main aspiration.
It takes a lot of effort and self-discipline.
I can already see real progress: …
It will be an important milestone for me because …
answers: Part 1 namunalari (faqat ustoz uchun): 1) I enjoy biology most, because it explains how our body works. For example, last week we studied the heart, and I couldn't put my textbook down.
2) It depends on the task. For tests I prefer studying alone, because I can focus better, but for big projects a group is more useful, since everyone brings different ideas.
3) It was small and friendly, just ten minutes from my house. I remember that every spring our class put on a short play for our parents, and I was always nervous but happy.

NAMUNA A (Band 5.5–6, 176 so'z, ~1.5–2 daqiqa, faqat ustoz uchun): I'd like to talk about a goal I want to achieve in the next three years: I want to get a place at a medical university in Tashkent and become a children's doctor. I set this target two years ago, when my little brother was ill and a young doctor at our local hospital looked after him so kindly. Since then, medicine has been my main aspiration. To achieve it, I'm doing a few things. First, I've put together a weekly plan: biology and chemistry every evening, and English three times a week, because a good IELTS certificate helps with university entrance. Second, I've stopped putting off revising difficult topics. I used to leave chemistry until the last minute, but procrastination only made me more nervous. It takes a lot of effort and self-discipline. However, I can see real progress: my last chemistry test was much better than the first one. This goal is important to me because I want to help families like mine, and finishing this course is the first milestone on that path.

Part 3 namunalari (umumiy, 3-shaxsda): 1) For most school students, face-to-face learning works better, because a teacher can see at once who is lost and explain the point again. However, online learning suits adults with a job: for example, many workers in Uzbekistan take evening courses online to get a certificate.

2) Only partly. An exam shows what a student remembers on one particular day, but not whether they can use it in real life. That's why teachers should also look at the progress a student makes during the whole year, for instance through projects and regular speaking tasks.

3) I think schools should teach practical things such as basic first aid, cooking simple meals and filling in an application form. Everyone needs these skills, whatever career path they choose. For example, a teenager who knows first aid can help someone in an accident before the ambulance arrives.
Baholash: S-4.0 — shu darsdagi F bo'lim jadvali ('Speaking rubrikasi — IELTS 4.0 (B1+), Part 1–3 (S-4.0)') + S-CHECK-4.0 (keyingi mashq); Final Speaking o'quvchilari — F ustuniga (12 ball).
why: Bugungi grammatika (PUT phrasal verbs): I've put together a weekly plan (tuzmoq), I've stopped putting off revising (put off + V-ing — keyinga surmoq); Part 1 da: couldn't put my textbook down, put on a short play.

EW 25 so'zlari: target — marra; aspiration — intilish, orzu-maqsad; university entrance — universitetga kirish; procrastination — paysalga solish; effort, self-discipline — mehnat, o'zini intizomlash; progress — o'sish; milestone — muhim bosqich; career path, certificate — Part 3 da.

Kartochkaning 4 bandi tartib bilan: maqsad nima (medical university) -> qachon qo'yilgan (two years ago, when …) -> nima qilyapti (First … Second …) -> nega muhim (because …). Part 3 javoblari 3 qismli: fikr + sabab + misol.

homework.title: Yozma ish: Final Writing paragrafini qayta yozing (120–150 so'z)
homework.instr: Final Writing bo'yicha feedback olgach, kirish va body paragrafni qayta yozing, feedback'dagi 2 ta asosiy xatoni tuzatib. Savol: "Nowadays many teenagers spend several hours a day on social media. Some people think this does more harm than good. To what extent do you agree or disagree?" Reja: Intro — paraphrase + pozitsiya / Body — topic sentence → explain → example → link.
answers: NAMUNA (Band 5.5–6, 130 so'z, original, faqat ustoz uchun): Today many teenagers spend a lot of their free time on social media. I mostly agree that this does more harm than good, because it can damage sleep and study. The biggest problem is that it is hard to stop scrolling. As a result, many students go to bed late and cannot concentrate in class. What is more, constant notifications make it difficult to focus on homework, so tasks take twice as long. For example, a friend of mine used to watch short videos until one o'clock at night, and his maths marks fell. However, the same apps can be useful for group homework. In short, social media is not harmful in itself, but spending several hours a day on it clearly does more harm than good for most teenagers.
Baholash: W-4.0 (4 mezon × 0–3 = 12) + feedback'dagi 2 xato tuzatilganmi.

homework.instr: QO'SHIMCHA (kurs yakuni). 1 daqiqa tayyorgarlik (faqat 5–6 kalit so'z), keyin 1.5–2 daqiqa to'xtamasdan gapirib, ovozli yozuvni 3 kun ichida ilovaga yuboring. Matndan o'qimang. items: KARTOCHKA B: Describe a skill you learned during this course. You should say: what the skill is; when and how you learned it; how often you use it now; and explain why it is useful for you.
answers: NAMUNA B (Band 5.5–6, 142 so'z, Jony Academy original, faqat ustoz uchun): A skill I learned during this course is planning a paragraph before I write it: topic sentence, explanation, example and link. I learned it in the middle of the course, when our teacher showed us a model paragraph and we put it together again from cut-up sentences. At first I thought planning was a waste of time, and I wanted to start writing immediately. But soon my paragraphs became clearer and I made fewer mistakes, so I stopped putting it off. Now I use this skill every week, not only in English but also in history and literature essays at school. It is useful for me because it saves time in exams, and the more I plan, the more confident I feel. I think it will also help me later with my university entrance essays and my long-term plan to study abroad.
Bugungi struktura: put it together, stopped putting it off; EW25: university entrance, long-term plan, study abroad.

reading.title: Oybek — the writer who never put down his pen
text: A  Musa Toshmuhammad o'g'li was born in Tashkent in 1905 into a craftsman's family. He loved poetry from an early age and began writing his own poems as a teenager. Later he took the pen name Oybek, which means "moon lord". He published his first poems in the 1920s, while he was a student in Tashkent, and later he taught at university there.

B  His biggest project began in the late 1930s. Oybek wanted to bring fifteenth-century Herat, the city of the great poet Alisher Navoi, back to life in one book. He put in years of research and read many old manuscripts about the poet and his time. When the Second World War began, many people had to put their plans aside, but Oybek kept writing. The novel "Navoiy" came out in 1944 and became one of the best-known books in Uzbek literature. He also put Pushkin's poetry into Uzbek and wrote the novel "Qutlug' qon" ("Sacred Blood").

C  Then came the hardest years. In the early 1950s some critics put his work down, and soon after that a serious illness took away his ability to speak clearly. He had to put up with poor health for the rest of his life. It was his wife, Zarifa Saidnosirova, who helped him through these years. He could no longer put his ideas across in speech, so he put them down on paper, and she helped him put his manuscripts together for editors.
D  Oybek did not give up, and he did not put off his writing. In these difficult years he wrote "Bolalik" ("Childhood"), a warm and funny book about old Tashkent, as well as more novels and poems.

E  Oybek died in 1968. Today a metro station in Tashkent has his name, his house has been turned into a museum, and his books are studied in schools. Teachers often tell their students that Oybek kept working even when life was very hard. The more you read about him, the more you understand one simple idea: big goals are reached one page at a time.
(Jony Academy tomonidan o'quv maqsadida yozilgan matn.)

tasks.title: ZAXIRA: Final test results — note completion (ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER)
tasks.instr: Eslatmani to'ldiring.
items: Results are ready in ___ working days.
The report goes to the student and the ___.
Pass mark to go to IELTS 5.0: ___ %
Also needed: at least ___ % in every section.
Conditional pass: retake the weak section within one ___.
Fail: ___ intensive sessions, then the final test again.
Next level after a pass: IELTS ___

transcript: USTOZ UCHUN: 2 marta o'qing; 1-rol — ustoz, 2-rol — kuchli o'quvchi (yoki ovozni o'zgartiring).
Receptionist: Good afternoon, Jony Academy. How can I help you?
Parent: Hello. My son took the IELTS 4.0 final test today. When will we get the results?
Receptionist: The teachers check every paper carefully, so it takes two working days. Not tomorrow, I'm afraid.
Parent: And who gets the results?
Receptionist: We send a report to the student and to the parents, with a score for every section.
Parent: What does he need to go on to the next level?
Receptionist: The pass mark is seventy per cent. Some parents think it's sixty, but sixty to sixty-nine is only a conditional pass.
Parent: So seventy in total is enough?
Receptionist: Not quite. He also needs at least fifty per cent in every section.
Parent: And after a conditional pass?
Receptionist: He retakes only the weak section, within one week.
Parent: And if he fails?
Receptionist: Then he has three — no, sorry, four — intensive sessions, and after that he takes the final test again.
Parent: And if he passes?
Receptionist: Then he moves up to IELTS 5.0. We'll call you about the new timetable.
